title.raw: 卷二十五 志第十五 天文三 Volume 25 Treatises 15: Astronomy 3

sentences.zh: 志第十五 天文三

translations.literal: Treatise 15: Astronomy 3
translations.idiomatic: Treatise 15: Astronomy 3

sentences.zh: 咸安二年正月己酉，歲星犯填星，在須女。

translations.literal: On the jiyou day of the first month of the second year of Xian'an, Jupiter encroached on Saturn in the Maiden and Female Servant asterism.
translations.idiomatic: On a jiyou day in the first month of Xian'an 2 (372 CE), Jupiter trespassed against Saturn in the Maiden and Female Servant asterisms.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「為內亂。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "This portends internal disorder.
translations.idiomatic: The omen was read as follows: "This foretells civil strife within the realm.

sentences.zh: 」五月，歲星形色如太白。

translations.literal: " In the fifth month Jupiter's color and form were like Venus.
translations.idiomatic: " In the fifth month, Jupiter's hue and appearance resembled Venus.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「進退如度，奸邪息。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "When it advances and retreats according to its proper motion, treachery subsides.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "When it moves forward and back in accord with its proper course, wickedness abates.

sentences.zh: 變色亂行，主無福。

translations.literal: When its color changes and it moves irregularly, the ruler will have no good fortune.
translations.idiomatic: If its color shifts and it strays from its path, the sovereign will know no blessing.

sentences.zh: 歲星囚于仲夏，當細小而不明，此其失常也；

translations.literal: Jupiter being constrained in midsummer should appear small and dim; this was its abnormal behavior;
translations.idiomatic: Jupiter, imprisoned in midsummer, ought to appear small and faint — this was its deviation from the norm;

sentences.zh: 又為臣強。

translations.literal: it also means the ministers are strong."
translations.idiomatic: it also signified that the ministers had grown powerful."

sentences.zh: 」六月，太白晝見在七星。

translations.literal: In the sixth month Venus was visible in daylight in the Seven Stars.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month, Venus shone by day in the Seven Stars asterism.

sentences.zh: 乙酉，太白犯輿鬼。

translations.literal: On yiyou day Venus encroached on the Celestial Cart and Ghost.
translations.idiomatic: On a yiyou day, Venus trespassed against the Celestial Cart and Ghost asterism.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「國有憂。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "The state will have cause for anxiety.
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "The realm will face grave concern.

sentences.zh: 」七月，帝疾甚，詔桓溫曰：「少子可輔者輔之；

translations.literal: " In the seventh month the emperor's illness grew severe, and he issued an edict to Huan Wen saying: "If any of my younger sons can be assisted, assist them;
translations.idiomatic: " In the seventh month the emperor's illness turned critical, and he addressed an edict to Huan Wen: "If any of my younger sons are fit to be aided, aid them;

sentences.zh: 如不可，君自取之。

translations.literal: if not, you may take the throne for yourself."
translations.idiomatic: if none are suitable, take the throne yourself."

sentences.zh: 」賴侍中王坦之毀手詔，改使如王導輔政故事。

translations.literal: Thanks to Attendant-in-Ordinary Wang Tanzhi, who destroyed the handwritten edict, the order was changed to follow the precedent of Wang Dao's regency.
translations.idiomatic: Only because Attendant-in-Ordinary Wang Tanzhi destroyed the autograph edict was the command revised to follow the precedent of Wang Dao's regency.

sentences.zh: 溫聞之大怒，將誅坦之等，內亂之應也。

translations.literal: When Wen heard of this he was furious and was about to execute Tanzhi and the others — the fulfillment of the internal disorder omen.
translations.idiomatic: When Wen learned of this he flew into a rage and was on the point of putting Tanzhi and his allies to death — the fulfillment of the omen of internal disorder.

sentences.zh: 是月，帝崩。

translations.literal: That month the emperor died.
translations.idiomatic: That same month the emperor died.

sentences.zh: 咸安二年五月丁未，太白犯天關。

translations.literal: On the dingwei day of the fifth month of the second year of Xian'an, Venus encroached on the Heavenly Gate.
translations.idiomatic: On a dingwei day in the fifth month of Xian'an 2, Venus trespassed against the Heavenly Gate asterism.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「兵起。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "Armies will rise.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "War will break out.

sentences.zh: 」六月，庾希入京城。

translations.literal: " In the sixth month Yu Xi entered the capital.
translations.idiomatic: " In the sixth month Yu Xi marched into the capital.

sentences.zh: 十一月，盧悚入宮，並誅滅。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month Lu Song entered the palace; both were executed and exterminated.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Lu Song forced his way into the palace; both men were executed and their factions wiped out.

sentences.zh: 甯康二年正月丁巳，有星孛於女虛，經氐、亢、角、軫、翼、張。

translations.literal: On the dingsi day of the first month of the second year of Ningkang, a broom star appeared in the Woman and Emptiness asterism, passing through Root, Neck, Horn, Chariot Crossbar, Wings, and Extended Net.
translations.idiomatic: On a dingsi day in the first month of Ningkang 2 (344 CE), a comet blazed in the Woman and Emptiness asterisms and swept through Root, Neck, Horn, Chariot Crossbar, Wings, and Extended Net.

sentences.zh: 九月丁醜，有星孛於天市。

translations.literal: On the dingchou day of the ninth month, a broom star appeared in the Heavenly Market.
translations.idiomatic: On a dingchou day in the ninth month, a comet appeared in the Heavenly Market enclosure.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸酉，太白奄熒惑，在營室。

translations.literal: On the guiyou day of the eleventh month, Venus covered Mars in the Encampment.
translations.idiomatic: On a guiyou day in the eleventh month, Venus eclipsed Mars in the Encampment asterism.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「金火合為爍，此災皆為兵喪。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "When metal and fire combine they blaze; these calamities all portend war and mourning.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "When the metal and fire stars unite they flare — every such calamity foretells war and death in arms.

sentences.zh: 」太元元年五月，氐賊苻堅伐涼州。

translations.literal: " In the fifth month of the first year of Taiyuan, the Di rebel Fu Jian attacked Liangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: " In the fifth month of Taiyuan 1 (376 CE), the Di chieftain Fu Jian invaded Liangzhou.

sentences.zh: 七月，氐破涼州，虜張天錫。

translations.literal: In the seventh month the Di forces broke Liangzhou and captured Zhang Tianxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month the Di overran Liangzhou and took Zhang Tianxi prisoner.

sentences.zh: 十一月，桓沖發三州軍軍淮、泗，桓豁亦遣軍備境上。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month Huan Chong mobilized armies from three provinces at the Huai and Si, and Huan Huo also sent troops to guard the border.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Huan Chong raised armies from three provinces and encamped them on the Huai and Si, while Huan Huo likewise dispatched forces to guard the frontier.

sentences.zh: 甯康二年閏月己未，月奄牽牛南星。

translations.literal: On the jiwei day of the intercalary month of the second year of Ningkang, the moon covered the southern star of Leading Ox.
translations.idiomatic: On a jiwei day in the intercalary month of Ningkang 2, the moon eclipsed the southern star of Leading Ox.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「左將軍死。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "The General of the Left will die.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "The General of the Left will perish.

sentences.zh: 」三年五月，北中郎將王坦之薨。

translations.literal: " In the fifth month of the third year, Grand General Who Pacifies the North Wang Tanzhi died.
translations.idiomatic: " In the fifth month of the third year, Grand General Who Pacifies the North Wang Tanzhi died.

sentences.zh: 晉孝武太元元年四月丙戌，熒惑犯南斗第三星。

translations.literal: On the bingxu day of the fourth month of the first year of Taiyuan under Emperor Xiaowu of Jin, Mars encroached on the third star of the Southern Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: On a bingxu day in the fourth month of Taiyuan 1, during the reign of Emperor Xiaowu of Jin, Mars trespassed against the third star of the Southern Dipper.

sentences.zh: 丙申，又奄第四星。

translations.literal: On bingshen day it again covered the fourth star.
translations.idiomatic: On a bingshen day it eclipsed the fourth star as well.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「兵大起，中國饑。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "Armies will rise on a great scale; the central lands will suffer famine.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "War will erupt on a vast scale, and the heartland will know famine.

sentences.zh: 」一曰：「有赦。

translations.literal: " Another reading says: "There will be an amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: " Another interpretation holds: "An amnesty will be proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 」八月癸酉，太白晝見在氐。

translations.literal: " On the guiyou day of the eighth month Venus was visible in daylight in the Root asterism.
translations.idiomatic: " On a guiyou day in the eighth month, Venus shone by day in the Root asterism.

sentences.zh: 氐，兗州分野。

translations.literal: Root is the terrestrial correlate of Yanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: The Root asterism corresponds to the territory of Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 九月，熒惑犯哭泣星，遂入羽林。

translations.literal: In the ninth month Mars encroached on the Weeping Star and then entered the Forest of Spears.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Mars crossed the Weeping Star and then entered the Forest of Spears asterism.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「天子有哭泣事，中軍兵起。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "The Son of Heaven will have cause to weep; the central army will rise.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "The emperor will mourn; the central armies will mobilize.

sentences.zh: 」十一月己未，月奄左角。

translations.literal: " On the jiwei day of the eleventh month the moon covered the Left Horn.
translations.idiomatic: " On a jiwei day in the eleventh month the moon eclipsed the Left Horn star.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「天子有兵。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "The Son of Heaven will have armies.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "The emperor will go to war.

sentences.zh: 」一曰：「國有憂。

translations.literal: " Another reading says: "The state will have cause for anxiety.
translations.idiomatic: " Another reading says: "The realm will face grave troubles.

sentences.zh: 」三年六月，熒惑守羽林。

translations.literal: " In the sixth month of the third year Mars stationed at the Forest of Spears.
translations.idiomatic: " In the sixth month of the third year Mars lingered in the Forest of Spears.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「禁兵大起。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "The palace guard armies will rise on a great scale.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "The imperial guard will mobilize in force.

sentences.zh: 」九月壬午，太白晝見在角，兗州分。

translations.literal: " On the renwu day of the ninth month Venus was visible in daylight in the Horn — the terrestrial correlate of Yanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: " On a renwu day in the ninth month Venus shone by day in the Horn asterism, which corresponds to Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 元年五月，大赦。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the first year there was a general amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the first year a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 三年八月，氐賊韋鐘入漢中東下，苻融寇樊、鄧，慕容暐圍襄陽，氐兗州刺史彭超圍彭城。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the third year the Di rebel Wei Zhong entered Hanzhong and marched east; Fu Rong raided Fan and Deng; Murong Wei besieged Xiangyang; the Di Governor of Yanzhou Peng Chao besieged Pengcheng.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the third year the Di chieftain Wei Zhong drove into Hanzhong and swept east; Fu Rong attacked Fan and Deng; Murong Wei laid siege to Xiangyang; and the Di Governor of Yanzhou Peng Chao invested Pengcheng.

sentences.zh: 四年二月，襄陽城陷，賊獲硃序。

translations.literal: In the second month of the fourth year Xiangyang fell and the rebels captured Zhu Xu.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the fourth year Xiangyang was lost and the enemy took Zhu Xu prisoner.

sentences.zh: 彭超舍彭城，獲吉挹。

translations.literal: Peng Chao abandoned Pengcheng and captured Ji Yi.
translations.idiomatic: Peng Chao withdrew from Pengcheng and seized Ji Yi.

sentences.zh: 彭超等聚廣陵三河眾五萬。

translations.literal: Peng Chao and others gathered fifty thousand men from the three commanderies of Guangling.
translations.idiomatic: Peng Chao and his allies mustered fifty thousand troops from the three Guangling commanderies.

sentences.zh: 於是征虜謝石次塗中，右衛毛安之、遊擊河間王曇之等次堂邑，發丹陽民丁，使尹張涉屯衛京都。

translations.literal: Thereupon General Who Punishes Barbarians Xie Shi encamped at Tuzhong; Right Guard Mao Anzhi, Mobile Commander Prince of Hejian Tan Zhi, and others encamped at Tangyi; militia were levied from Danyang; and Intendant Zhang She was sent to garrison and defend the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In response General Who Punishes Barbarians Xie Shi took position at Tuzhong, while Right Guard Mao Anzhi, Mobile Commander the Prince of Hejian Tan Zhi, and others encamped at Tangyi; levies were raised from the commoners of Danyang; and Intendant Zhang She was stationed to defend the capital.

sentences.zh: 六月，兗州刺史謝玄討賊，大破之，餘燼皆走。

translations.literal: In the sixth month Governor of Yanzhou Xie Xuan attacked the rebels, inflicted a great defeat on them, and the remaining embers all fled.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month the Governor of Yanzhou Xie Xuan routed the enemy in a crushing victory, and every last remnant of their force scattered in flight.

sentences.zh: 是時中外連兵，比年荒儉。

translations.literal: At that time warfare continued at home and abroad, and year after year brought famine and want.
translations.idiomatic: At that time war raged without cease at court and on the frontiers, and famine stalked the land year upon year.

sentences.zh: 是年，又發揚州萬人戍夏口。

translations.literal: That year ten thousand men from Yangzhou were also dispatched to garrison Xiakou.
translations.idiomatic: That same year another ten thousand men from Yangzhou were levied to garrison Xiakou.

sentences.zh: 太元四年十一月丁巳，太白犯哭星。

translations.literal: On the dingsi day of the eleventh month of the fourth year of Taiyuan, Venus encroached on the Weeping Star.
translations.idiomatic: On a dingsi day in the eleventh month of Taiyuan 4, Venus trespassed against the Weeping Star.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「天子有哭泣事。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "The Son of Heaven will have cause to weep.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "The emperor will mourn.

sentences.zh: 」五年七月丙子，辰星犯軒轅。

translations.literal: " On the bingzi day of the seventh month of the fifth year Mercury encroached on the Yellow Dragon.
translations.idiomatic: " On a bingzi day in the seventh month of the fifth year, Mercury crossed the Yellow Dragon asterism.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「女主當之。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "The chief consort will be affected.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "The empress will bear the omen.

sentences.zh: 」九月癸未，皇后王氏崩。

translations.literal: " On the guiwei day of the ninth month Empress Wang died.
translations.idiomatic: " On a guiwei day in the ninth month Empress Wang died.

sentences.zh: 太元六年十月乙卯，有奔星東南經翼軫，聲如雷。

translations.literal: On the yimao day of the tenth month of the sixth year of Taiyuan, a shooting star passed southeast through Wings and Chariot Crossbar with a sound like thunder.
translations.idiomatic: On a yimao day in the tenth month of Taiyuan 6, a bolide streaked southeast through the Wings and Chariot Crossbar asterisms, thundering as it went.

sentences.zh: 《星說》曰：「光跡相連曰流，絕跡而去曰奔。

translations.literal: The Treatise on Stars says: "When light-trails link together it is called a meteor; when the trail breaks off and departs it is called a shooting star.
translations.idiomatic: The Treatise on Stars explains: "A streak of light that leaves a continuous trail is termed a meteor; one whose trail breaks off and vanishes is termed a bolide.

sentences.zh: 」案占：「楚地有兵。

translations.literal: " According to prognostication: "There will be armies in the Chu region.
translations.idiomatic: " The omen was read as: "War will break out in the Chu territories.

sentences.zh: 」一曰：「軍破民流。

translations.literal: " Another reading says: "Armies will be broken and the people will flee.
translations.idiomatic: " Another interpretation holds: "Armies will be shattered and the populace will scatter in flight.

sentences.zh: 」十二月，氐荊州刺史梁成、襄陽太守閻震率眾伐竟陵，桓石虔擊大破之，生禽震，斬首七千，獲生萬人。

translations.literal: " In the twelfth month the Di Governor of Jingzhou Liang Cheng and Administrator of Xiangyang Yan Zhen led their forces to attack Jingling; Huan Shiqian struck and inflicted a great defeat, capturing Zhen alive, beheading seven thousand, and taking ten thousand prisoners.
translations.idiomatic: " In the twelfth month the Di Governor of Jingzhou Liang Cheng and the Administrator of Xiangyang Yan Zhen marched against Jingling; Huan Shiqian routed them utterly, took Zhen alive, severed seven thousand heads, and captured ten thousand men.

sentences.zh: 聲如雷，將帥怒之象也。

translations.literal: A sound like thunder is the image of generals and commanders in wrath.
translations.idiomatic: The thunderous roar symbolized the fury of commanders in the field.

sentences.zh: 七年九月，硃綽擊襄陽，拔將六百餘家而還。

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the seventh year Zhu Chuo attacked Xiangyang, carried off more than six hundred commanders' households, and returned.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the seventh year Zhu Chuo raided Xiangyang, carried off the families of more than six hundred officers, and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 太元七年十一月，太白晝見，在鬥。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the seventh year of Taiyuan Venus was visible in daylight in the Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of Taiyuan 7, Venus shone by day in the Dipper asterism.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「吳有兵喪。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "Wu will suffer war and mourning.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "The Wu region will know war and death in arms.

sentences.zh: 」八年四月甲子，太白又晝見，在參。

translations.literal: " On the jiazi day of the fourth month of the eighth year Venus was again visible in daylight in the Three Stars.
translations.idiomatic: " On a jiazi day in the fourth month of the eighth year, Venus again shone by day in the Three Stars asterism.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「魏有兵喪。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "Wei will suffer war and mourning.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "The Wei territories will know war and mourning.

sentences.zh: 」是月，桓沖征沔漢，楊亮伐蜀，並拔城略地。

translations.literal: " That month Huan Chong campaigned in the Mian and Han, Yang Liang attacked Shu, and both captured cities and seized territory.
translations.idiomatic: " That same month Huan Chong campaigned along the Mian and Han rivers, Yang Liang invaded Shu, and both seized cities and extended their holdings.

sentences.zh: 八月，苻堅自將號百萬，九月，攻沒壽陽。

translations.literal: In the eighth month Fu Jian personally led his army, claiming a million men; in the ninth month he attacked and captured Shouyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Fu Jian took the field in person at the head of an army he claimed numbered a million; in the ninth month he stormed and took Shouyang.

sentences.zh: 十月，劉牢之破堅將梁成斬之，殺獲萬餘人。

translations.literal: In the tenth month Liu Laozhi defeated Fu Jian's general Liang Cheng and beheaded him, killing and capturing more than ten thousand.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Liu Laozhi routed Fu Jian's general Liang Cheng and struck off his head, slaying and capturing more than ten thousand men.

sentences.zh: 謝玄等又破堅于淝水，斬其弟融，堅大眾奔潰。

translations.literal: Xie Xuan and others again defeated Fu Jian at the Fei River, beheaded his brother Rong, and Fu Jian's great host fled in rout.
translations.idiomatic: Xie Xuan and his allies then shattered Fu Jian's forces at the Fei River, struck down his brother Rong, and Fu Jian's vast army broke and fled in panic.

sentences.zh: 九年六月，皇太后褚氏崩。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the ninth year the Empress Dowager of the Chu clan died.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the ninth year the Empress Dowager Chu died.

sentences.zh: 八月，謝玄出屯彭城，經略中州。

translations.literal: In the eighth month Xie Xuan marched out to garrison Pengcheng and take control of the central provinces.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Xie Xuan advanced to encamp at Pengcheng and extend Jin control over the central provinces.

sentences.zh: 十年八月，苻堅為其將姚萇所殺。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of the tenth year Fu Jian was killed by his general Yao Chang.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the tenth year Fu Jian was slain by his own general Yao Chang.

sentences.zh: 太元十年十二月己醜，太白犯歲星。

translations.literal: On the jichou day of the twelfth month of the tenth year of Taiyuan, Venus encroached on Jupiter.
translations.idiomatic: On a jichou day in the twelfth month of Taiyuan 10, Venus trespassed against Jupiter.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「為兵饑。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "This portends war and famine.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "This foretells war and famine.

sentences.zh: 」是時河朔未一，兵連在外，冬，大饑。

translations.literal: " At that time the north of the Yellow River was not yet unified; warfare continued abroad; in winter there was great famine.
translations.idiomatic: " At that time the lands north of the Yellow River remained divided; armies campaigned without cease beyond the borders; and that winter famine struck with terrible force.

sentences.zh: 太元十一年三月戊申，太白晝見，在東井。

translations.literal: On the wushen day of the third month of the eleventh year of Taiyuan, Venus was visible in daylight in the Eastern Well.
translations.idiomatic: On a wushen day in the third month of Taiyuan 11, Venus shone by day in the Eastern Well asterism.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「秦有兵，臣強。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "Qin will have armies; ministers will be strong.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "Qin will go to war, and the ministers will grow powerful.

sentences.zh: 」六月甲午，歲星晝見，在胃。

translations.literal: " On the jiawu day of the sixth month Jupiter was visible in daylight in the Stomach.
translations.idiomatic: " On a jiawu day in the sixth month, Jupiter shone by day in the Stomach asterism.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「魯有兵，臣強。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "Lu will have armies; ministers will be strong.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "Lu will know war, and the ministers will grow powerful.

sentences.zh: 」十二年，慕容垂寇東阿，翟遼寇河上，姚萇假號安定，苻登自立隴上，呂光竊據涼土。

translations.literal: " In the twelfth year Murong Chui raided Dong'e; Zhai Liao raided the banks of the Yellow River; Yao Chang assumed the title at Anding; Fu Deng declared himself on the Longshang; Lü Guang seized the Liang territories.
translations.idiomatic: " In the twelfth year Murong Chui invaded Dong'e, Zhai Liao harried the Yellow River frontier, Yao Chang proclaimed himself ruler at Anding, Fu Deng raised his standard on the Longshang plateau, and Lü Guang seized the Liang territories.

sentences.zh: 太元十一年三月，客星在南斗，至六月乃沒。

translations.literal: In the third month of the eleventh year of Taiyuan a guest star appeared in the Southern Dipper and did not vanish until the sixth month.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of Taiyuan 11 a guest star blazed in the Southern Dipper and lingered until the sixth month before it disappeared.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「有兵。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "There will be armies.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "War will break out.

sentences.zh: 」一曰：「有赦。

translations.literal: " Another reading says: "There will be an amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: " Another interpretation holds: "An amnesty will be proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 」是後司、雍、兗、冀常有兵役。

translations.literal: " Thereafter Si, Yong, Yan, and Ji frequently saw military service.
translations.idiomatic: " Thereafter the provinces of Si, Yong, Yan, and Ji were continually embroiled in warfare.

sentences.zh: 十二年正月，大赦。

translations.literal: In the first month of the twelfth year there was a general amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the twelfth year a general amnesty was proclaimed.

sentences.zh: 八月，又赦。

translations.literal: In the eighth month there was another amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month another amnesty followed.

sentences.zh: 太元十二年二月戊寅，熒惑入月。

translations.literal: On the wuyin day of the second month of the twelfth year of Taiyuan, Mars entered the moon.
translations.idiomatic: On a wuyin day in the second month of Taiyuan 12, Mars entered the moon.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「有亂臣死，相若有戮者。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "Rebellious ministers will die; among the chief ministers some will be executed.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "Treacherous ministers will perish, and among the highest ministers some will be put to death.

sentences.zh: 」一曰：「女親為敗，天下亂。

translations.literal: " Another reading says: "Female kin will cause defeat; the realm will fall into disorder.
translations.idiomatic: " Another interpretation holds: "Women of the imperial clan will bring ruin, and the realm will descend into chaos.

sentences.zh: 」是時琅邪王輔政，王妃從兄國寶以姻昵受寵。

translations.literal: " At that time the Prince of Langye served as regent; the prince consort's cousin Wang Guobao won favor through marital intimacy.
translations.idiomatic: " At that time the Prince of Langye held the regency, and the empress's cousin Wang Guobao won the emperor's favor through their family ties.

sentences.zh: 又陳郡人袁悅昧私苟進，交遘主相，扇揚朋黨。

translations.literal: Moreover Yuan Yue of Chen commandery advanced through secretive private dealings, colluded between sovereign and chief minister, and fanned factional cliques.
translations.idiomatic: Meanwhile Yuan Yue of Chen, advancing through covert intrigue, played sovereign and chief minister against each other and inflamed partisan factions.

sentences.zh: 十三年，帝殺悅。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year the emperor executed Yue.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year the emperor had Yue put to death.

sentences.zh: 於是主相有隙，亂階興矣。

translations.literal: Thereupon a rift opened between sovereign and chief minister, and the prelude to disorder arose.
translations.idiomatic: From that point a breach opened between emperor and chief minister, and the seeds of turmoil were sown.

sentences.zh: 太元十二年十月庚午，太白晝見，在鬥。

translations.literal: On the gengwu day of the tenth month of the twelfth year of Taiyuan, Venus was visible in daylight in the Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: On a gengwu day in the tenth month of Taiyuan 12, Venus shone by day in the Dipper asterism.

sentences.zh: 十三年閏月戊辰，天狗東北下有聲。

translations.literal: On the wuchen day of the intercalary month of the thirteenth year the Heavenly Dog in the northeast produced a sound.
translations.idiomatic: On a wuchen day in the intercalary month of the thirteenth year the Heavenly Dog omen in the northeast thundered.

sentences.zh: 十二月戊子，辰星入月，在危。

translations.literal: On the wuzi day of the twelfth month Mercury entered the moon in the Rooftop asterism.
translations.idiomatic: On a wuzi day in the twelfth month, Mercury entered the moon in the Rooftop asterism.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「賊臣欲殺主，不出三年，必有內惡。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "A treacherous minister wishes to kill his sovereign; within three years there will surely be internal wickedness.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "A rebel minister plots against the throne; within three years internal treachery will surely erupt.

sentences.zh: 」是月，熒惑在角亢，形色猛盛。

translations.literal: " That month Mars was in the Horn and Neck, its color and form fierce and brilliant.
translations.idiomatic: " That same month Mars blazed in the Horn and Neck asterisms, its hue and brilliance unnaturally fierce.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「熒惑失其常，吏且棄其法，諸侯亂其政。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "When Mars loses its proper course, officials will abandon the law and feudal lords will throw government into disorder.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "When Mars strays from its proper path, officials will cast aside the law and regional lords will throw governance into chaos.

sentences.zh: 」自是後慕容垂、翟遼、姚萇、苻登、慕容永並阻兵爭強。

translations.literal: " Thereafter Murong Chui, Zhai Liao, Yao Chang, Fu Deng, and Murong Yong all blocked the roads with armies and contended for supremacy.
translations.idiomatic: " Thereafter Murong Chui, Zhai Liao, Yao Chang, Fu Deng, and Murong Yong all raised armies and vied for dominance across the north.

sentences.zh: 十四年正月，彭城妖賊又稱號於皇丘，劉牢之破滅之。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fourteenth year rebel bandits at Pengcheng again proclaimed a title at Huangqiu; Liu Laozhi defeated and destroyed them.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the fourteenth year, rebel chieftains at Pengcheng again raised a standard at Huangqiu; Liu Laozhi routed and annihilated them.

sentences.zh: 三月，張道破合鄉，圍泰山，向欽之擊走之。

translations.literal: In the third month Zhang Dao broke Hexiang, besieged Mount Tai, and Xiang Qinzhi struck and drove him off.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Zhang Dao overran Hexiang and invested Mount Tai; Xiang Qinzhi attacked and drove him back.

sentences.zh: 是年，翟遼又攻沒滎陽，侵略陳、項。

translations.literal: That year Zhai Liao again attacked and captured Xingyang, raiding Chen and Xiang.
translations.idiomatic: That same year Zhai Liao again stormed Xingyang and swept through Chen and Xiang.

sentences.zh: 于時政事多弊，治道陵遲矣。

translations.literal: At that time government affairs were full of abuses, and the path of good governance had fallen into decline.
translations.idiomatic: By then government was riddled with corruption, and the foundations of orderly rule had crumbled.

sentences.zh: 太元十四年十二月，熒惑入羽林。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the fourteenth year of Taiyuan Mars entered the Forest of Spears.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of Taiyuan 14, Mars entered the Forest of Spears asterism.

sentences.zh: 乙未，月犯歲星。

translations.literal: On yiwei day the moon encroached on Jupiter.
translations.idiomatic: On a yiwei day the moon trespassed against Jupiter.

sentences.zh: 占並同上。

translations.literal: The prognostications are the same as above.
translations.idiomatic: The omens were read as above.

sentences.zh: 十五年，翟遼陸掠司、兗，眾軍累討弗克。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year Zhai Liao repeatedly raided Si and Yan; the armies sent against him time and again could not overcome him.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year Zhai Liao harried Si and Yan without cease, and the imperial forces sent against him repeatedly failed to bring him down.

sentences.zh: 鮮卑又跨略並、冀。

translations.literal: The Xianbei also overran and seized Bing and Ji.
translations.idiomatic: The Xianbei likewise overran Bing and Ji.

sentences.zh: 七月，旱。

translations.literal: In the seventh month there was drought.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month drought struck.

sentences.zh: 八月，諸郡大水，兗州又蝗。

translations.literal: In the eighth month many commanderies suffered great floods, and Yanzhou was also afflicted by locusts.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month floods ravaged commanderies across the realm, and locusts descended upon Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 太元十五年七月壬申，有星孛於北河戒，經太微、三台、文昌，入北斗，長十餘丈。

translations.literal: On the renshen day of the seventh month of the fifteenth year of Taiyuan, a broom star appeared at the Northern River Guard, passing through Supreme Palace Enclosure, Three Terraces, and Literary Glory, entering the Northern Dipper, more than ten zhang in length.
translations.idiomatic: On a renshen day in the seventh month of Taiyuan 15, a comet blazed at the Northern River Guard, sweeping through the Supreme Palace Enclosure, Three Terraces, and Literary Glory asterisms and into the Northern Dipper, its tail stretching more than ten zhang.

sentences.zh: 八月戊戌，入紫微，乃滅。

translations.literal: On the wuxu day of the eighth month it entered the Purple Forbidden Enclosure and then vanished.
translations.idiomatic: On a wuxu day in the eighth month it entered the Purple Forbidden Enclosure and then disappeared.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「北河戒，一名胡門。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "The Northern River Guard is also called the Barbarian Gate.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "The Northern River Guard, also known as the Barbarian Gate,

sentences.zh: 胡門有兵喪。

translations.literal: At the Barbarian Gate there will be war and mourning.
translations.idiomatic: portends war and death in arms among the frontier peoples.

sentences.zh: 掃太微，入紫微，王者當之。

translations.literal: Sweeping through Supreme Palace Enclosure and entering Purple Forbidden Enclosure, the Son of Heaven will be affected.
translations.idiomatic: Sweeping the Supreme Palace Enclosure and entering the Purple Forbidden Enclosure, the sovereign himself will bear the omen.

sentences.zh: 三台為三公，文昌為將相，將相三公有災。

translations.literal: Three Terraces represent the three dukes; Literary Glory represents generals and chief ministers — generals, chief ministers, and the three dukes will suffer calamity.
translations.idiomatic: The Three Terraces stand for the three highest ministers, Literary Glory for generals and chief ministers — generals, ministers, and the three highest offices will all know disaster.

sentences.zh: 入北斗，強國發兵，諸侯爭權，大夫憂。

translations.literal: Entering the Northern Dipper, powerful states will raise armies, feudal lords will contend for power, and great officers will suffer anxiety.
translations.idiomatic: Its entry into the Northern Dipper means powerful states will mobilize, regional lords will fight for supremacy, and high ministers will be gripped by dread.

sentences.zh: 」十一月，太白入羽林。

translations.literal: " In the eleventh month Venus entered the Forest of Spears.
translations.idiomatic: " In the eleventh month Venus entered the Forest of Spears.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「天子為軍自守，有反臣。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "The Son of Heaven will garrison armies to defend himself; there will be rebellious ministers.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "The emperor will muster armies for his own defense; rebel ministers will arise.

sentences.zh: 」二十一年九月，孝武帝崩。

translations.literal: " In the ninth month of the twenty-first year Emperor Xiaowu died.
translations.idiomatic: " In the ninth month of the twenty-first year Emperor Xiaowu died.

sentences.zh: 隆安元年，王恭、殷仲堪、桓玄等併發兵表誅王國寶，朝廷從而殺之，並斬其從弟緒，司馬道子由是失勢，禍亂成矣。

translations.literal: In the first year of Long'an, Wang Gong, Yin Zhongkan, Huan Xuan, and others all raised armies and submitted memorials demanding the execution of Wang Guobao; the court complied and killed him, and also beheaded his cousin Xu; Sima Daozi thereby lost power, and calamity and disorder took shape.
translations.idiomatic: In Long'an 1, Wang Gong, Yin Zhongkan, Huan Xuan, and others all took the field and memorialized the throne demanding Wang Guobao's death; the court acquiesced and executed him along with his cousin Xu; Sima Daozi lost his grip on power from that moment, and the stage was set for catastrophe.

sentences.zh: 太元十六年十一月癸巳，月奄心前星。

translations.literal: On the guisi day of the eleventh month of the sixteenth year of Taiyuan, the moon covered the anterior star of the Heart.
translations.idiomatic: On a guisi day in the eleventh month of Taiyuan 16, the moon eclipsed the anterior star of the Heart asterism.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「太子憂。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "The heir apparent will suffer anxiety.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "The crown prince will be afflicted.

sentences.zh: 」是時太子常有篤疾。

translations.literal: " At that time the heir apparent frequently suffered serious illness.
translations.idiomatic: " At that time the crown prince was chronically gravely ill.

sentences.zh: 太元十七年九月丁醜，歲星、熒惑、填星同在亢氐。

translations.literal: On the dingchou day of the ninth month of the seventeenth year of Taiyuan, Jupiter, Mars, and Saturn were together in the Neck and Root.
translations.idiomatic: On a dingchou day in the ninth month of Taiyuan 17, Jupiter, Mars, and Saturn converged in the Neck and Root asterisms.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「三星合，是謂驚位絕行，內外有兵喪與饑，改立王公。」

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "When the three stars unite, this is called startling the throne and cutting off the proper course; at home and abroad there will be war, mourning, and famine; princes and dukes will be replaced."
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "When the three stars converge, it is termed a disruption of the celestial order — war and famine will strike within and without, and new lords will be installed upon the throne."

sentences.zh: 太元十八年正月乙酉，熒惑入月。

translations.literal: On the yiyou day of the first month of the eighteenth year of Taiyuan, Mars entered the moon.
translations.idiomatic: On a yiyou day in the first month of Taiyuan 18, Mars entered the moon.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「憂在宮中，非賊乃盜也。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "Anxiety lies within the palace; if not a traitor, then a thief.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "Trouble will strike within the palace walls — if not a traitor, then a thief.

sentences.zh: 」一曰：「有亂臣，若有戮者。

translations.literal: " Another reading says: "There will be rebellious ministers; some among the chief ministers will be executed.
translations.idiomatic: " Another interpretation holds: "Rebellious ministers will arise, and some among the highest ministers will be put to death.

sentences.zh: 」二十一年九月，帝暴崩內殿，兆庶宣言夫人張氏潛行大逆。

translations.literal: " In the ninth month of the twenty-first year the emperor suddenly died in the inner palace; the common people proclaimed that Lady Zhang had secretly committed great treason.
translations.idiomatic: " In the ninth month of the twenty-first year the emperor died suddenly in the inner palace, and the populace openly charged that Lady Zhang had secretly committed regicide.

sentences.zh: 于時朝政暗緩，不加顯戮，但默責而已。

translations.literal: At that time court governance was obscure and lax; no public execution was carried out, but only silent censure.
translations.idiomatic: At the time the court was too timid and indecisive to impose open punishment, contenting itself with private rebuke.

sentences.zh: 又王國寶邪狡，卒伏其辜。

translations.literal: Moreover Wang Guobao was wicked and cunning; in the end he suffered for his crimes.
translations.idiomatic: Meanwhile Wang Guobao's treachery and cunning caught up with him, and in the end he paid for his crimes.

sentences.zh: 太元十八年二月，有客星在尾中，至九月乃滅。

translations.literal: In the second month of the eighteenth year of Taiyuan a guest star appeared in the Tail and did not vanish until the ninth month.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of Taiyuan 18 a guest star blazed in the Tail asterism and lingered until the ninth month before it disappeared.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「燕有兵喪。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "Yan will suffer war and mourning.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "The state of Yan will know war and death in arms.

sentences.zh: 」十九年四月己巳，月奄歲星，在尾。

translations.literal: " On the jisi day of the fourth month of the nineteenth year the moon covered Jupiter in the Tail.
translations.idiomatic: " On a jisi day in the fourth month of the nineteenth year the moon eclipsed Jupiter in the Tail asterism.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「為饑，燕國亡。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "This portends famine; the state of Yan will perish.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "This foretells famine and the fall of Yan.

sentences.zh: 」二十年，慕容垂遣息寶伐什圭，為圭所破，死者數萬人。

translations.literal: " In the twentieth year Murong Chui sent his son Bao to attack Shigui; he was defeated by Shigui and tens of thousands died.
translations.idiomatic: " In the twentieth year Murong Chui sent his son Murong Bao against Tuoba Gui; Gui routed him and tens of thousands perished.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，垂死，國遂衰亡。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year Chui died and the state thereafter declined and perished.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-first year Murong Chui died, and the state thereafter withered toward extinction.

sentences.zh: 太元十九年十月癸醜，太白犯歲星，在鬥。

translations.literal: On the guichou day of the tenth month of the nineteenth year of Taiyuan, Venus encroached on Jupiter in the Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: On a guichou day in the tenth month of Taiyuan 19, Venus trespassed against Jupiter in the Dipper asterism.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「為饑，為內兵。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "This portends famine and internal warfare.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "This foretells famine and civil war.

sentences.zh: 鬥，吳、越分。

translations.literal: The Dipper is the terrestrial correlate of Wu and Yue.
translations.idiomatic: The Dipper asterism corresponds to the territories of Wu and Yue.

sentences.zh: 」至隆安元年，王恭等舉兵顯王國寶之罪，朝廷赦之。

translations.literal: " By the first year of Long'an, Wang Gong and others raised armies to expose Wang Guobao's crimes; the court granted them amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: " By Long'an 1, Wang Gong and his allies had taken the field to denounce Wang Guobao's crimes, and the court granted them amnesty.

sentences.zh: 是後連歲水旱民饑。

translations.literal: Thereafter year after year brought floods, drought, and famine among the people.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter floods and drought alternated year upon year, and the people starved.

sentences.zh: 太元二十年六月，熒惑入天囷。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the twentieth year of Taiyuan Mars entered the Heavenly Granary.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of Taiyuan 20, Mars entered the Heavenly Granary asterism.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「天下饑。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "The realm will suffer famine.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "Famine will stalk the land.

sentences.zh: 」七月丁亥，太白入太微。

translations.literal: " On the dinghai day of the seventh month Venus entered Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: " On a dinghai day in the seventh month, Venus entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「太白入太微，國有憂。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "When Venus enters Supreme Palace Enclosure, the state will have cause for anxiety.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "When Venus enters the Supreme Palace Enclosure, the realm will face grave concern.

sentences.zh: 晝見，為兵喪。

translations.literal: When visible in daylight, it portends war and mourning.
translations.idiomatic: If it shines by day, war and death in arms will follow.

sentences.zh: 」九月，有蓬星如粉絮，東南行，曆女虛至哭星。

translations.literal: " In the ninth month there was a disheveled star like powdered floss, moving southeast, passing through Woman and Emptiness to the Weeping Star.
translations.idiomatic: " In the ninth month a hazy star like drifting cotton floss moved southeast, sweeping from the Woman and Emptiness asterisms to the Weeping Star.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「蓬星見，不出三年，必有亂臣戮死於市。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "When the disheveled star appears, within three years there will surely be rebellious ministers executed in the marketplace.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "When the disheveled star appears, within three years rebel ministers will surely be put to death in the public square.

sentences.zh: 」十二月己巳，月犯楗閉及東西鹹。

translations.literal: " On the jisi day of the twelfth month the moon encroached on Key and Lock and the Eastern and Western Flavors.
translations.idiomatic: " On a jisi day in the twelfth month the moon trespassed against Key and Lock and the Eastern and Western Flavors stars.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「楗閉司心腹喉舌，東西鹹主陰謀。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "Key and Lock govern the heart, belly, throat, and tongue; the Eastern and Western Flavors preside over secret plots.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "Key and Lock govern the sovereign's inner counsellors and spokesmen; the Eastern and Western Flavors preside over covert intrigue.

sentences.zh: 」是時王國寶交構朝政。

translations.literal: " At that time Wang Guobao was weaving intrigues through court governance.
translations.idiomatic: " At that time Wang Guobao was manipulating court politics through secret machinations.

sentences.zh: 二十一年九月，帝崩；

translations.literal: In the ninth month of the twenty-first year the emperor died;
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month of the twenty-first year the emperor died;

sentences.zh: 隆安元年，王恭等舉兵，而朝廷戮王國寶、王緒。

translations.literal: in the first year of Long'an Wang Gong and others raised armies, and the court executed Wang Guobao and Wang Xu.
translations.idiomatic: in Long'an 1 Wang Gong and his allies took the field, and the court put Wang Guobao and Wang Xu to death.

sentences.zh: 又連歲水旱，兼三方動眾，民饑。

translations.literal: Moreover floods and drought continued year after year; armies mobilized on three fronts; and the people starved.
translations.idiomatic: Floods and drought persisted year upon year, armies marched on three fronts, and the people went hungry.

sentences.zh: 太元二十一年三月，太白連晝見，在羽林。

translations.literal: In the third month of the twenty-first year of Taiyuan Venus was repeatedly visible in daylight in the Forest of Spears.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of Taiyuan 21, Venus shone by day for many days running in the Forest of Spears.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「有強臣，有兵喪，中軍兵起。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "There will be powerful ministers, war and mourning, and the central army will rise.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "Powerful ministers will arise, war and mourning will follow, and the central armies will mobilize.

sentences.zh: 」四月壬午，太白入天囤。

translations.literal: " On the renwu day of the fourth month Venus entered the Heavenly Storehouse.
translations.idiomatic: " On a renwu day in the fourth month, Venus entered the Heavenly Storehouse asterism.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「為饑。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "This portends famine.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "This foretells famine.

sentences.zh: 」六月，歲星犯哭星。

translations.literal: " In the sixth month Jupiter encroached on the Weeping Star.
translations.idiomatic: " In the sixth month Jupiter trespassed against the Weeping Star.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「有哭泣事。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "There will be cause for weeping.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "The court will mourn.

sentences.zh: 」是年九月，孝武帝崩。

translations.literal: " In the ninth month of that year Emperor Xiaowu died.
translations.idiomatic: " In the ninth month of that year Emperor Xiaowu died.

sentences.zh: 隆安元年，王恭舉兵脅朝廷，於是中外戒嚴，戮王國寶以謝之。

translations.literal: In the first year of Long'an Wang Gong raised armies to coerce the court; thereupon the realm was placed on alert at home and abroad, and Wang Guobao was executed to appease him.
translations.idiomatic: In Long'an 1 Wang Gong took the field to coerce the court; the realm was placed on full alert, and Wang Guobao was executed to placate him.

sentences.zh: 晉安帝隆安元年正月癸亥，熒惑犯哭星。

translations.literal: On the guihai day of the first month of the first year of Long'an under Emperor An of Jin, Mars encroached on the Weeping Star.
translations.idiomatic: On a guihai day in the first month of Long'an 1, during the reign of Emperor An of Jin, Mars trespassed against the Weeping Star.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「有哭泣事。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "There will be cause for weeping.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "The court will mourn.

sentences.zh: 」二月，歲星熒惑皆入羽林。

translations.literal: " In the second month both Jupiter and Mars entered the Forest of Spears.
translations.idiomatic: " In the second month both Jupiter and Mars entered the Forest of Spears.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「軍兵起。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "Armies will rise.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "Armies will mobilize.

sentences.zh: 」四月丁醜，太白晝見，在東井。

translations.literal: " On the dingchou day of the fourth month Venus was visible in daylight in the Eastern Well.
translations.idiomatic: " On a dingchou day in the fourth month, Venus shone by day in the Eastern Well asterism.

sentences.zh: 秦有兵喪。

translations.literal: Qin will suffer war and mourning.
translations.idiomatic: Qin will know war and death in arms.

sentences.zh: 是月，王恭舉兵，內外戒嚴。

translations.literal: That month Wang Gong raised armies and the realm was placed on alert at home and abroad.
translations.idiomatic: That same month Wang Gong took the field and the court declared a general alert throughout the realm.

sentences.zh: 尋殺王國寶等。

translations.literal: Shortly thereafter Wang Guobao and others were killed.
translations.idiomatic: Before long Wang Guobao and his allies were put to death.

sentences.zh: 六月，羌賊攻洛陽，郗恢遣兵救之。

translations.literal: In the sixth month Qiang rebels attacked Luoyang; Xi Hui dispatched troops to rescue it.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Qiang rebels besieged Luoyang, and Xi Hui sent troops to its relief.

sentences.zh: 姚萇死，子略代立。

translations.literal: Yao Chang died and his son Lue succeeded him.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Chang died and his son Yao Xing succeeded to his position.

sentences.zh: 什圭自號於中山。

translations.literal: Shigui proclaimed himself at Zhongshan.
translations.idiomatic: Tuoba Gui declared himself ruler at Zhongshan.

sentences.zh: 隆安元年六月庚午，月奄太白，在太微端門外。

translations.literal: On the gengwu day of the sixth month of the first year of Long'an the moon covered Venus outside the End Gate of Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: On a gengwu day in the sixth month of Long'an 1, the moon eclipsed Venus just outside the End Gate of the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「國受兵。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "The state will suffer military attack.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "The realm will come under arms.

sentences.zh: 」乙酉，月奄歲星，在東壁。

translations.literal: " On yiyou day the moon covered Jupiter in the Eastern Wall.
translations.idiomatic: " On a yiyou day the moon eclipsed Jupiter in the Eastern Wall asterism.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「為饑。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "This portends famine.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "This foretells famine.

sentences.zh: 衛地有兵。

translations.literal: The territory of Wei will have armies.
translations.idiomatic: The Wei territories will see war.

sentences.zh: 」八月，熒惑守井鉞。

translations.literal: " In the eighth month Mars stationed at the Well Axe.
translations.idiomatic: " In the eighth month Mars lingered at the Well Axe star.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「大臣有誅。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "Great ministers will be executed.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "High ministers will be put to death.

sentences.zh: 」二年六月戊辰，攝提移度失常，歲星晝見在胃。

translations.literal: " On the wuchen day of the sixth month of the second year Sheti shifted its degree abnormally; Jupiter was visible in daylight in the Stomach.
translations.idiomatic: " On a wuchen day in the sixth month of the second year the Sheti asterism shifted from its proper position; Jupiter shone by day in the Stomach asterism.

sentences.zh: 胃，兗州分。

translations.literal: The Stomach is the terrestrial correlate of Yanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: The Stomach asterism corresponds to the territory of Yanzhou.

sentences.zh: 是年六月，郗恢遣鄧啟方等以萬人殘虜於滑台。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of that year Xi Hui sent Deng Qifang and others with ten thousand men to ravage the barbarians at Huatai.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of that year Xi Hui dispatched Deng Qifang and others with ten thousand men to strike the enemy at Huatai.

sentences.zh: 滑台，衛地也。

translations.literal: Huatai lies in the territory of Wei.
translations.idiomatic: Huatai lies within the Wei territories.

sentences.zh: 啟方等敗而還。

translations.literal: Qifang and the others were defeated and returned.
translations.idiomatic: Qifang and his force were beaten and withdrew in defeat.

sentences.zh: 九月，王恭、庾楷、殷仲堪、桓玄等並舉兵表誅王愉、司馬尚之兄弟。

translations.literal: In the ninth month Wang Gong, Yu Kai, Yin Zhongkan, Huan Xuan, and others all raised armies and submitted memorials demanding the execution of Wang Yu and the brothers Sima Shangzhi.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Wang Gong, Yu Kai, Yin Zhongkan, Huan Xuan, and others all took the field and memorialized the throne demanding the deaths of Wang Yu and the brothers Sima Shangzhi.

sentences.zh: 於是內外戒嚴，大發民眾。

translations.literal: Thereupon the realm was placed on alert at home and abroad and the populace was levied on a great scale.
translations.idiomatic: The court declared a general alert and levied the populace on a vast scale.

sentences.zh: 仲堪軍至尋陽，禽江州刺史王愉，楷將段方攻尚之于楊湖，為所敗，方死。

translations.literal: Zhongkan's army reached Xunyang and captured Wang Yu, Governor of Jiangzhou; Kai's general Duan Fang attacked Shangzhi at Yanghu, was defeated by him, and Fang died.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongkan's army reached Xunyang and seized Wang Yu, the Governor of Jiangzhou; Kai's general Duan Fang attacked Shangzhi at Yanghu, was routed, and Fang was killed.

sentences.zh: 王恭司馬劉牢之反恭，恭敗。

translations.literal: Wang Gong's Major Liu Laozhi turned against Gong, and Gong was defeated.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Gong's chief officer Liu Laozhi turned against him, and Gong was defeated.

sentences.zh: 桓玄至白石，亦奔退。

translations.literal: Huan Xuan reached Baishi but also fled and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: Huan Xuan advanced as far as Baishi but likewise broke off and retreated.

sentences.zh: 仲堪還江陵。

translations.literal: Zhongkan returned to Jiangling.
translations.idiomatic: Zhongkan withdrew to Jiangling.

sentences.zh: 三年冬，荊州刺史殷仲堪為桓玄所殺。

translations.literal: In the winter of the third year Governor of Jingzhou Yin Zhongkan was killed by Huan Xuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of the third year the Governor of Jingzhou Yin Zhongkan was slain by Huan Xuan.

sentences.zh: 隆安二年閏月，太白晝見，在羽林。

translations.literal: In the intercalary month of the second year of Long'an Venus was visible in daylight in the Forest of Spears.
translations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month of Long'an 2, Venus shone by day in the Forest of Spears.

sentences.zh: 丁醜，月犯東上相。

translations.literal: On dingchou day the moon encroached on the Eastern Upper Prime Minister.
translations.idiomatic: On a dingchou day the moon trespassed against the Eastern Upper Prime Minister star.

sentences.zh: 三年五月辛酉，月又奄東上相。

translations.literal: On the xinyou day of the fifth month of the third year the moon again covered the Eastern Upper Prime Minister.
translations.idiomatic: On a xinyou day in the fifth month of the third year, the moon once again eclipsed the Eastern Upper Prime Minister star.

sentences.zh: 辛未，辰星犯軒轅星。

translations.literal: On xinwei day Mercury encroached on the Yellow Dragon star.
translations.idiomatic: On a xinwei day Mercury trespassed against the Yellow Dragon star.

sentences.zh: 占悉同上。

translations.literal: The prognostications are all the same as above.
translations.idiomatic: All omens were read as above.

sentences.zh: 是年正月，楊佺期破郗恢，奪其任，殷仲堪又殺之。

translations.literal: In the first month of that year Yang Quanqi defeated Xi Hui, stripped him of his post, and Yin Zhongkan also killed him.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of that year Yang Quanqi routed Xi Hui and seized his command; Yin Zhongkan then had him killed.

sentences.zh: 六月，鮮卑攻沒青州。

translations.literal: In the sixth month the Xianbei attacked and overran Qingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month the Xianbei overran Qingzhou.

sentences.zh: 十月，羌賊攻沒洛陽。

translations.literal: In the tenth month Qiang bandits attacked and overran Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Qiang rebels captured Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 桓玄破荊、雍，殺殷仲堪、楊佺期。

translations.literal: Huan Xuan broke Jing and Yong and killed Yin Zhongkan and Yang Quanqi.
translations.idiomatic: Huan Xuan conquered Jing and Yong and slew Yin Zhongkan and Yang Quanqi.

sentences.zh: 孫恩聚眾攻沒會稽，殺內史王凝之，劉牢之東討走之。

translations.literal: Sun En gathered a host, attacked and overran Kuaiji, killed the Administrator Wang Ningzhi, and Liu Laozhi marched east to campaign against him and drive him off.
translations.idiomatic: Sun En raised an army, seized Kuaiji, and killed the Administrator Wang Ningzhi; Liu Laozhi marched east against him and put him to flight.

sentences.zh: 四年七月，太皇太后李氏崩。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the fourth year Grand Empress Dowager Lady Li passed away.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the fourth year Grand Empress Dowager Li died.

sentences.zh: 隆安四年正月乙亥，月犯填星，在牽牛。

translations.literal: On the yihai day of the first month of the fourth year of Long'an the moon encroached on Saturn in Leading Ox.
translations.idiomatic: On a yihai day in the first month of Long'an 4, the moon trespassed against Saturn in the Leading Ox asterism.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「吳、越有兵喪。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "Wu and Yue will suffer war and mourning.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "Wu and Yue will know war and death in arms.

sentences.zh: 女主憂。

translations.literal: The empress will suffer anxiety.
translations.idiomatic: The ruling lady will be afflicted with grief.

sentences.zh: 」二月己醜，有星孛於奎，長三丈，上至閣道紫宮西蕃，入鬥魁，至三台、太微、帝座、端門。

translations.literal: " On the jichou day of the second month a broom star appeared at Kui, three zhang in length, reaching upward to the western rampart of Celestial Pathway and Purple Forbidden Enclosure, entering the Dipper Head, and reaching Three Terraces, Supreme Palace Enclosure, Imperial Seat, and End Gate.
translations.idiomatic: " On a jichou day in the second month a comet blazed at Kui, its tail three zhang long, sweeping up to the western rampart of Celestial Pathway and the Purple Forbidden Enclosure, entering the Dipper Head, and reaching the Three Terraces, Supreme Palace Enclosure, Imperial Seat, and End Gate stars.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「彗拂天子廷閣，易主之象。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "When a comet brushes the Son of Heaven's court and pavilion, it is the image of changing rulers.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "When a comet sweeps the imperial court and its halls, it portends a change of sovereign.

sentences.zh: 」經三台，入北斗，占同上條。

translations.literal: " Passing through the Three Terraces and entering the Northern Dipper — the prognostication is the same as in the entry above.
translations.idiomatic: " Sweeping the Three Terraces and entering the Northern Dipper — the omen was read as in the preceding entry.

sentences.zh: 六月己未，月又犯填星，在牽牛。

translations.literal: On the jiwei day of the sixth month the moon again encroached on Saturn in Leading Ox.
translations.idiomatic: On a jiwei day in the sixth month the moon once again trespassed against Saturn in Leading Ox.

sentences.zh: 辛酉，又犯哭星。

translations.literal: On xinyou day it again encroached on the Weeping Star.
translations.idiomatic: On a xinyou day it trespassed against the Weeping Star once more.

sentences.zh: 十月，奄歲星在北河。

translations.literal: In the tenth month it covered Jupiter in the Northern River.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month it eclipsed Jupiter in the Northern River asterism.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「為饑。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "This portends famine.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "This foretells famine.

sentences.zh: 」十二月戊寅，有星孛于貫索、天市、天津。

translations.literal: " On the wuyin day of the twelfth month a broom star appeared at Coiled Thong, Celestial Market Enclosure, and Celestial Ford.
translations.idiomatic: " On a wuyin day in the twelfth month a comet blazed at Coiled Thong, the Celestial Market Enclosure, and Celestial Ford.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「貴臣獄死，內外有兵喪。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "Noble ministers will die in prison; at home and abroad there will be war and mourning.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "Great ministers will perish in the dungeons; war and mourning will strike both within and without.

sentences.zh: 天津為賊斷，王道天下不通。

translations.literal: When Celestial Ford is severed by bandits, the royal way will not run through the realm.
translations.idiomatic: When Celestial Ford is cut by rebels, the king's highway will no longer pass through the land.

sentences.zh: 」十二月，太白在鬥晝見，至五年正月乙卯。

translations.literal: " From the twelfth month Venus was visible in daylight in the Dipper, until the yimao day of the first month of the fifth year.
translations.idiomatic: " From the twelfth month Venus shone by day in the Dipper asterism, and remained so until a yimao day in the first month of the fifth year.

sentences.zh: 案占，災在吳、越。

translations.literal: According to prognostication, the calamity will be in Wu and Yue.
translations.idiomatic: The omen was read to mean the calamity would fall upon Wu and Yue.

sentences.zh: 三月甲寅，流星赤色眾多，西行經牽牛、虛、危、天津、閣道，貫太微、紫宮。

translations.literal: On the jiayin day of the third month many red meteors traveled west, passing through Leading Ox, Emptiness, Rooftop, Celestial Ford, and Celestial Pathway, and piercing Supreme Palace Enclosure and Purple Forbidden Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: On a jiayin day in the third month many crimson meteors streaked westward through Leading Ox, Emptiness, Rooftop, Celestial Ford, and Celestial Pathway, cutting through the Supreme Palace Enclosure and Purple Forbidden Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「星者庶民，類眾多西流之象。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "Stars represent the common people; many of them flowing westward is the image of the multitude.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "Stars stand for the common folk; a host of them streaming westward images mass flight of the people.

sentences.zh: 徑行天子庭，主弱臣強，諸侯兵不制。

translations.literal: Passing straight through the Son of Heaven's court: the ruler weak and ministers strong; the feudal lords' armies beyond control.
translations.idiomatic: Cutting straight through the imperial court means a weak sovereign and powerful ministers, with the warlords' armies beyond restraint.

sentences.zh: 」七月癸亥，大角星散搖五色。

translations.literal: " On the guihai day of the seventh month the Great Horn star scattered and swayed in five colors.
translations.idiomatic: " On a guihai day in the seventh month the Great Horn star flickered and shimmered in five colors.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「王者流散。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "The kingly rulers will scatter and flee.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "The sovereign and his house will be driven into exile.

sentences.zh: 」丁卯，月犯天關。

translations.literal: " On dingmao day the moon encroached on the Celestial Gate.
translations.idiomatic: " On a dingmao day the moon trespassed against the Celestial Gate star.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「王者憂。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "The king will suffer anxiety.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "The sovereign will be gripped with dread.

sentences.zh: 」九月庚子，熒惑犯少微，又守之。

translations.literal: " On the gengzi day of the ninth month Mars encroached on the Lesser Supreme Enclosure and then stationed there.
translations.idiomatic: " On a gengzi day in the ninth month Mars trespassed against the Lesser Supreme Enclosure and then lingered there.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「處士誅。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "Reclusive scholars will be executed.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "Men of learning in retirement will be put to death.

sentences.zh: 」十月戊子，月犯東蕃次相。

translations.literal: " On the wuzi day of the tenth month the moon encroached on the Eastern Rampart Second Minister.
translations.idiomatic: " On a wuzi day in the tenth month the moon trespassed against the Eastern Rampart second-rank minister star.

sentences.zh: 四年五月，孫恩複破會稽，殺內史謝琰；

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the fourth year Sun En again broke Kuaiji and killed the Administrator Xie Yan;
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the fourth year Sun En again seized Kuaiji and killed the Administrator Xie Yan;

sentences.zh: 遣高雅之等討之。

translations.literal: Gao Yazhi and others were dispatched to campaign against him.
translations.idiomatic: The court sent Gao Yazhi and others to suppress him.

sentences.zh: 七月，太皇太后李氏崩。

translations.literal: In the seventh month Grand Empress Dowager Lady Li passed away.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month Grand Empress Dowager Li died.

sentences.zh: 十月，妖賊大破高雅之于余姚，死者十七八。

translations.literal: In the tenth month demonic bandits inflicted a great defeat on Gao Yazhi at Yuyao; seven or eight out of ten were killed.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month the rebel forces routed Gao Yazhi at Yuyao, and seven or eight out of every ten men perished.

sentences.zh: 五年二月，孫恩攻句章，高祖拒之。

translations.literal: In the second month of the fifth year Sun En attacked Gouzhang and Emperor Gaozu (Liu Yu) resisted him.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the fifth year Sun En assaulted Gouzhang and Emperor Gaozu (Liu Yu) barred his advance.

sentences.zh: 五月，吳郡內史袁山松出戰，為所殺，死者數千人。

translations.literal: In the fifth month Yuan Shansong, Administrator of Wu Commandery, went out to battle and was killed by the enemy; several thousand died.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Yuan Shansong, the Administrator of Wu Commandery, took the field and was slain; several thousand men lost their lives.

sentences.zh: 六月，孫恩至京口，高祖擊破之。

translations.literal: In the sixth month Sun En reached Jingkou and Emperor Gaozu (Liu Yu) struck and broke him.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Sun En advanced to Jingkou, and Emperor Gaozu (Liu Yu) routed him.

sentences.zh: 恩軍蒲洲，於是內外戒嚴，營陣屯守，柵斷淮口。

translations.literal: En's army encamped at Puzhou; thereupon the realm was placed on alert at home and abroad, camps and battle lines were garrisoned, and palisades blocked the Huai River mouth.
translations.idiomatic: En's army lay at Puzhou; the court then declared a general alert throughout the realm, deployed garrisons in fortified camps, and sealed the mouth of the Huai with barricades.

sentences.zh: 恩遣別將攻廣陵，殺三千餘人。

translations.literal: En dispatched a separate general to attack Guangling and killed more than three thousand people.
translations.idiomatic: En sent a detached commander against Guangling and slaughtered more than three thousand people.

sentences.zh: 恩遁據鬱洲。

translations.literal: En fled and seized Yuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: En fled and occupied Yuzhou.

sentences.zh: 是月，高祖又追破之。

translations.literal: That month Emperor Gaozu (Liu Yu) again pursued him and broke him.
translations.idiomatic: That same month Emperor Gaozu (Liu Yu) pursued him again and defeated him.

sentences.zh: 九月，桓玄表至，逆旨陵上。

translations.literal: In the ninth month Huan Xuan's memorial arrived, defying the imperial will and insulting the sovereign.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Huan Xuan's memorial reached the capital, defying the throne and showing insolence toward the sovereign.

sentences.zh: 十月，司馬元顯大治水軍，將以伐玄。

translations.literal: In the tenth month Sima Yuanyao greatly built up the naval forces, intending to campaign against Xuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Sima Yuanyao mustered a great fleet, preparing to march against Huan Xuan.

sentences.zh: 元興元年正月，桓玄東下。

translations.literal: In the first month of the first year of Yuanxing Huan Xuan marched east downstream.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Yuanxing 1, Huan Xuan marched east down the Yangtze.

sentences.zh: 是月，孫恩在臨海，人眾餓死散亡，恩亦投水死。

translations.literal: That month Sun En was at Linhai; his followers starved, died, and scattered in flight, and En also threw himself into the water and died.
translations.idiomatic: That same month Sun En was at Linhai; famine and death broke his army apart, and En himself drowned.

sentences.zh: 盧循自稱征虜將軍，領其餘眾，略有永嘉、晉安之地。

translations.literal: Lu Xun styled himself Campaign-General Who Subdues the Barbarians, took command of the remaining host, and seized parts of Yongjia and Jin'an.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Xun proclaimed himself Campaign-General Who Subdues the Barbarians, took over the surviving rebel forces, and occupied parts of Yongjia and Jin'an.

sentences.zh: 二月，帝戎服遣西軍。

translations.literal: In the second month the emperor, in martial dress, dispatched the Western Army.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month the emperor, clad for battle, sent out the Western Army.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，桓玄至姑孰，破曆陽，司馬尚之見殺，劉牢之降于玄。

translations.literal: On dingmao day Huan Xuan reached Gudu, broke Liyang, Sima Shangzhi was killed, and Liu Laozhi surrendered to Xuan.
translations.idiomatic: On a dingmao day Huan Xuan reached Gudu, took Liyang, Sima Shangzhi was slain, and Liu Laozhi surrendered to him.

sentences.zh: 三月，玄克京都，殺司馬元顯，放太傅道子。

translations.literal: In the third month Xuan seized the capital, killed Sima Yuanyao, and released the Grand Tutor Daozi.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Huan Xuan captured the capital, put Sima Yuanyao to death, and banished the Grand Tutor Daozi.

sentences.zh: 七月，大饑，人相食。

translations.literal: In the seventh month there was great famine and people ate one another.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month famine reached such extremes that people turned to cannibalism.

sentences.zh: 浙江東餓死流亡十六七，吳郡、吳興戶口減半；

translations.literal: East of the Zhe River, six or seven out of ten starved to death or fled as refugees; the registered households of Wu Commandery and Wuxing were reduced by half;
translations.idiomatic: East of the Zhe River six or seven out of every ten people starved or fled as refugees, and the registered population of Wu Commandery and Wuxing was cut in half;

sentences.zh: 又流奔而西者萬計。

translations.literal: and those who fled westward numbered in the tens of thousands.
translations.idiomatic: while tens of thousands more fled westward.

sentences.zh: 十月，桓玄遣將擊劉軌，破走奔青州。

translations.literal: In the tenth month Huan Xuan dispatched a general to attack Liu Gui, broke him and put him to flight, and he fled to Qingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Huan Xuan sent a general against Liu Gui, routed him, and drove him to flee into Qingzhou.

sentences.zh: 四年，玄遂篡位，遷帝尋陽。

translations.literal: In the fourth year Xuan then usurped the throne and moved the emperor to Xunyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year Huan Xuan seized the throne and relocated the emperor to Xunyang.

sentences.zh: 晉安帝元興元年三月戊子，太白犯五諸侯，因晝見。

translations.literal: On the wuzi day of the third month of the first year of Yuanxing under Emperor An of Jin, Venus encroached on the Five Feudal Lords and was visible in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: On a wuzi day in the third month of Yuanxing 1, during the reign of Emperor An of Jin, Venus trespassed against the Five Feudal Lords and shone by day.

sentences.zh: 四月辛醜，月奄辰星。

translations.literal: On the xinchou day of the fourth month the moon covered Mercury.
translations.idiomatic: On a xinchou day in the fourth month the moon eclipsed Mercury.

sentences.zh: 七月戊寅，熒惑在東井，熒惑犯輿鬼、積屍，占並同上。

translations.literal: On the wuyin day of the seventh month Mars was in the Eastern Well; Mars encroached on the Carriage Ghost and Accumulated Corpses — the prognostications are the same as above.
translations.idiomatic: On a wuyin day in the seventh month Mars stood in the Eastern Well and trespassed against the Carriage Ghost and Accumulated Corpses — the omens were read as above.

sentences.zh: 八月庚子，太白犯歲星，在上將東南。

translations.literal: On the gengzi day of the eighth month Venus encroached on Jupiter southeast of the Upper General.
translations.idiomatic: On a gengzi day in the eighth month Venus trespassed against Jupiter southeast of the Upper General star.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「楚兵饑。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "The Chu armies will suffer famine.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "The armies of Chu will know hunger.

sentences.zh: 」一曰：「災在上將。

translations.literal: " Another reading says: "The calamity falls upon the Upper General.
translations.idiomatic: " Another interpretation holds: "The disaster will strike the Upper General.

sentences.zh: 」丙寅，太白奄右執法。

translations.literal: " On the bingyin day Venus covered the Right Law Enforcer.
translations.idiomatic: " On a bingyin day Venus eclipsed the Right Law Enforcer star.

sentences.zh: 九月癸未，太白犯進賢。

translations.literal: On the guiwei day of the ninth month Venus encroached on Promoted Worthy.
translations.idiomatic: On a guiwei day in the ninth month Venus trespassed against the Promoted Worthy star.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「賢者誅。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "Worthy men will be executed.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "Men of talent will be put to death.

sentences.zh: 」十月，客星色白如粉絮，在太微西，至十二月，入太微。

translations.literal: " In the tenth month a guest star, white as powdered cotton floss, stood west of the Supreme Palace Enclosure; by the twelfth month it entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: " In the tenth month a guest star pale as drifting cotton floss appeared west of the Supreme Palace Enclosure, and by the twelfth month it had entered the enclosure itself.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「兵入天子庭。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "Armies will enter the Son of Heaven's court.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "Armed men will enter the imperial court.

sentences.zh: 」二年二月，歲星犯西上將。

translations.literal: " In the second month of the second year Jupiter encroached on the Western Upper General.
translations.idiomatic: " In the second month of the second year Jupiter trespassed against the Western Upper General star.

sentences.zh: 六月甲辰，奄鬥第四星。

translations.literal: On the jiachen day of the sixth month it covered the fourth star of the Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: On a jiachen day in the sixth month it eclipsed the fourth star of the Dipper asterism.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「大臣誅，不出三年。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "Great ministers will be executed, within no more than three years.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "High ministers will be put to death within three years.

sentences.zh: 」八月癸醜，太白犯房北第二星。

translations.literal: " On the guichou day of the eighth month Venus encroached on the second northern star of the Room.
translations.idiomatic: " On a guichou day in the eighth month Venus trespassed against the second northern star of the Room asterism.

sentences.zh: 九月己醜，歲星犯進賢，熒惑犯西上將。

translations.literal: On the jichou day of the ninth month Jupiter encroached on Promoted Worthy and Mars encroached on the Western Upper General.
translations.idiomatic: On a jichou day in the ninth month Jupiter trespassed against the Promoted Worthy star and Mars against the Western Upper General star.

sentences.zh: 十月甲戌，太白犯泣星。

translations.literal: On the jiaxu day of the tenth month Venus encroached on the Weeping Star.
translations.idiomatic: On a jiaxu day in the tenth month Venus trespassed against the Weeping Star.

sentences.zh: 十一月丁醜，熒惑犯填星。

translations.literal: On the dingchou day of the eleventh month Mars encroached on Saturn.
translations.idiomatic: On a dingchou day in the eleventh month Mars trespassed against Saturn.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，月犯熒惑。

translations.literal: On xinsi day the moon encroached on Mars.
translations.idiomatic: On a xinsi day the moon trespassed against Mars.

sentences.zh: 十二月乙巳，月奄軒轅第二星，占悉同上。

translations.literal: On the yisi day of the twelfth month the moon covered the second star of the Yellow Dragon — the prognostications are all the same as above.
translations.idiomatic: On a yisi day in the twelfth month the moon eclipsed the second star of the Yellow Dragon — all omens were read as above.

sentences.zh: 元年冬，索頭破羌軍。

translations.literal: In the winter of the first year Suotou broke the Qiang armies.
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of the first year the Tuoba (Suotou) routed the Qiang forces.

sentences.zh: 二年十二月，桓玄篡位，放遷帝后于尋陽，以永安何皇后為零陵君。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the second year Huan Xuan usurped the throne, deposed and relocated the emperor and empress to Xunyang, and made Empress He of Yong'an the Lady of Lingling.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the second year Huan Xuan seized the throne, banished the emperor and empress to Xunyang, and reduced Empress He of Yong'an to the title Lady of Lingling.

sentences.zh: 三年二月，高祖盡誅桓氏。

translations.literal: In the second month of the third year Emperor Gaozu (Liu Yu) executed the entire Huan clan to the last.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the third year Emperor Gaozu (Liu Yu) exterminated the Huan clan to the last man.

sentences.zh: 元興三年正月戊戌，熒惑逆行犯太微西上相。

translations.literal: On the wuxu day of the first month of the third year of Yuanxing Mars moved in retrograde and encroached on the Western Upper Prime Minister of the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: On a wuxu day in the first month of Yuanxing 3, Mars turned retrograde and trespassed against the Western Upper Prime Minister star of the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「天子戰于野，上相死。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "The Son of Heaven will do battle in the field and the Upper Prime Minister will die.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "The emperor will go to war in the field and the chief prime minister will perish.

sentences.zh: 」二月甲辰，月奄歲星于左角。

translations.literal: " On the jiachen day of the second month the moon covered Jupiter at the Left Horn.
translations.idiomatic: " On a jiachen day in the second month the moon eclipsed Jupiter at the Left Horn star.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「天下兵起。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "Armies will rise throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "War will break out across the empire.

sentences.zh: 」丙辰，熒惑逆行在左執法西北。

translations.literal: " On bingchen day Mars moved in retrograde northwest of the Left Law Enforcer.
translations.idiomatic: " On a bingchen day Mars turned retrograde northwest of the Left Law Enforcer star.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「執法者憂。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "The law enforcer will suffer anxiety.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "The censorial minister will be afflicted with dread.

sentences.zh: 」四月甲午，月奄軒轅第二星，填星入羽林，十二月，熒惑太白皆犯羽林，占同上。

translations.literal: " On the jiawu day of the fourth month the moon covered the second star of the Yellow Dragon; Saturn entered the Forest of Spears; in the twelfth month both Mars and Venus encroached on the Forest of Spears — the prognostication is the same as above.
translations.idiomatic: " On a jiawu day in the fourth month the moon eclipsed the second star of the Yellow Dragon; Saturn entered the Forest of Spears; in the twelfth month both Mars and Venus trespassed against the Forest of Spears — the omen was read as above.

sentences.zh: 是年二月丙辰，高祖殺桓修等。

translations.literal: On the bingchen day of the second month of that year Emperor Gaozu (Liu Yu) killed Huan Xiu and others.
