translations.idiomatic: On a bingchen day in the second month of that year Emperor Gaozu (Liu Yu) executed Huan Xiu and his allies.

sentences.zh: 三月己未，破走桓玄，遣軍西討。

translations.literal: On the jiwei day of the third month he broke Huan Xuan and put him to flight, and dispatched armies west to campaign against him.
translations.idiomatic: On a jiwei day in the third month he routed Huan Xuan and put him to flight, then sent troops west in pursuit.

sentences.zh: 辛巳，誅左僕射王愉及子荊州刺史綏。

translations.literal: On xinsi day he executed Left Vice Director Wang Yu and his son Sui, Governor of Jingzhou.
translations.idiomatic: On a xinsi day he put to death Left Vice Director Wang Yu and his son Sui, the Governor of Jingzhou.

sentences.zh: 桓玄劫帝如江陵。

translations.literal: Huan Xuan seized the emperor and took him to Jiangling.
translations.idiomatic: Huan Xuan abducted the emperor and carried him off to Jiangling.

sentences.zh: 五月，玄下至崢嶸洲，義軍破滅之。

translations.literal: In the fifth month Xuan went downstream to Zhengrong Isle and the loyalist armies broke and destroyed him.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Huan Xuan sailed down to Zhengrong Isle, where the loyalist armies crushed him.

sentences.zh: 桓振又攻沒江陵，幽劫天子。

translations.literal: Huan Zhen again attacked and overran Jiangling and secretly seized the emperor.
translations.idiomatic: Huan Zhen again captured Jiangling and held the emperor captive.

sentences.zh: 明年正月，眾軍攻之，振走，乘輿乃旋。

translations.literal: In the first month of the following year the combined armies attacked him; Zhen fled, and the imperial carriage then returned.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the following year the allied armies attacked him; Zhen fled, and the imperial carriage at last returned.

sentences.zh: 七月，永安何皇后崩。

translations.literal: In the seventh month Empress He of Yong'an passed away.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month Empress He of Yong'an died.

sentences.zh: 三月，桓振又襲江陵，荊州刺史司馬休之敗走。

translations.literal: In the third month Huan Zhen again raided Jiangling, and Governor of Jingzhou Sima Xiuzhi was defeated and fled.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Huan Zhen struck at Jiangling again; Sima Xiuzhi, the Governor of Jingzhou, was defeated and fled.

sentences.zh: 是月，劉懷肅擊振滅之。

translations.literal: That month Liu Huaisu attacked Zhen and destroyed him.
translations.idiomatic: That same month Liu Huaisu struck at Huan Zhen and wiped him out.

sentences.zh: 其年二月，巴西人譙縱殺益州刺史毛璩及璩弟西夷校尉瑾，跨有西土，自號蜀王。

translations.literal: In the second month of that year Qiao Zong of Baxi killed Governor of Yizhou Mao Qi and Qi's younger brother Jin, Commander of the Western Barbarians, seized the western territories, and styled himself King of Shu.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of that year Qiao Zong of Baxi killed the Governor of Yizhou Mao Qi and Mao Qi's younger brother Mao Jin, the Commander of the Western Barbarians, took possession of the western lands, and proclaimed himself King of Shu.

sentences.zh: 晉安帝義熙元年三月壬辰，月奄左執法，占同上。

translations.literal: On the renchen day of the third month of the first year of Yiyuan under Emperor An of Jin, the moon covered the Left Law Enforcer — the prognostication is the same as above.
translations.idiomatic: On a renchen day in the third month of Yiyuan 1, during the reign of Emperor An of Jin, the moon eclipsed the Left Law Enforcer star — the omen was read as above.

sentences.zh: 丁酉，月奄心前星。

translations.literal: On dingyou day the moon covered the anterior star of the Heart.
translations.idiomatic: On a dingyou day the moon eclipsed the anterior star of the Heart asterism.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「豫州有災。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "Yuzhou will suffer calamity.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "Calamity will strike Yuzhou.

sentences.zh: 」太白犯東井。

translations.literal: " Venus encroached on the Eastern Well.
translations.idiomatic: " Venus trespassed against the Eastern Well asterism.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「秦有兵。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "Qin will have armies.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "Qin will go to war.

sentences.zh: 」四月己卯，月犯填星，在東壁。

translations.literal: " On the jimao day of the fourth month the moon encroached on Saturn in the Eastern Wall.
translations.idiomatic: " On a jimao day in the fourth month the moon trespassed against Saturn in the Eastern Wall asterism.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「其地亡國。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "That region's state will perish.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "The state in that quarter will fall.

sentences.zh: 」一曰：貴人死。

translations.literal: " Another reading says: "Nobles will die.
translations.idiomatic: " Another interpretation holds: "Great personages will perish.

sentences.zh: 」七月庚辰，太白比晝見，在翼、軫。

translations.literal: " On the gengchen day of the seventh month Venus was visible in daylight at about noon in the Wings and Chariot Crossbar.
translations.idiomatic: " On a gengchen day in the seventh month Venus shone by day near midday in the Wings and Chariot Crossbar asterisms.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「為臣強。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "The ministers will be strong.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "The ministers will grow powerful.

sentences.zh: 荊州有兵喪。

translations.literal: Jingzhou will have war and mourning.
translations.idiomatic: Jingzhou will know war and death in arms.

sentences.zh: 」己未，月奄填星，在東壁。

translations.literal: " On the jiwei day the moon covered Saturn in the Eastern Wall.
translations.idiomatic: " On a jiwei day the moon eclipsed Saturn in the Eastern Wall asterism.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「其國以伐亡。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "Its state will perish through warfare.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "That kingdom will fall in war.

sentences.zh: 」一曰：「民流。

translations.literal: " Another reading says: "The people will flee.
translations.idiomatic: " Another interpretation holds: "The common folk will scatter in flight.

sentences.zh: 」八月丁巳，月犯鬥第一星。

translations.literal: " On the dingsi day of the eighth month the moon encroached on the first star of the Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: " On a dingsi day in the eighth month the moon trespassed against the first star of the Dipper asterism.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「天下有兵。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "Armies will rise throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "War will break out across the empire.

sentences.zh: 」一曰：「大臣憂。

translations.literal: " Another reading says: "Great ministers will suffer anxiety.
translations.idiomatic: " Another interpretation holds: "High ministers will be afflicted with dread.

sentences.zh: 」案江左來，南斗有災，則吳越會稽、丹陽、豫章、廬江各隨其星應之。

translations.literal: " Examining records since the court moved south of the Yangtze, when the Southern Dipper suffers calamity, Wu, Yue, Kuaiji, Danyang, Yuzhang, and Lujiang each respond according to its star.
translations.idiomatic: " Surveying the records since the Jin court withdrew to the south, when portents strike the Southern Dipper, Wu, Yue, Kuaiji, Danyang, Yuzhang, and Lujiang each manifest the omen in turn according to its corresponding star.

sentences.zh: 淮南失土，殆不占耳。

translations.literal: Huainan had already lost its territory — hardly worth prognosticating.
translations.idiomatic: Huainan had long since lost its lands to the north — scarcely a region worth reading in the stars.

sentences.zh: 史闕其說，故不列焉。

translations.literal: The histories omit that explanation, so it is not set forth here.
translations.idiomatic: The earlier annals pass over this reading in silence, and so it is not entered here.

sentences.zh: 九月戊子，熒惑犯少微。

translations.literal: On the wuzi day of the ninth month Mars encroached on the Lesser Supreme Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: On a wuzi day in the ninth month Mars trespassed against the Lesser Supreme Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「處士誅。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "Reclusive scholars will be executed.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "Men of learning in retirement will be put to death.

sentences.zh: 」庚寅，熒惑犯右執法。

translations.literal: " On the gengyin day Mars encroached on the Right Law Enforcer.
translations.idiomatic: " On a gengyin day Mars trespassed against the Right Law Enforcer star.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，熒惑犯左執法。

translations.literal: On the guimao day Mars encroached on the Left Law Enforcer.
translations.idiomatic: On a guimao day Mars trespassed against the Left Law Enforcer star.

sentences.zh: 占並同上。

translations.literal: The prognostications are all the same as above.
translations.idiomatic: All omens were read as above.

sentences.zh: 十月丁巳，月奄填星營室，占同七月。

translations.literal: On the dingsi day of the tenth month the moon covered Saturn at the Encampment — the prognostication is the same as in the seventh month.
translations.idiomatic: On a dingsi day in the tenth month the moon eclipsed Saturn at the Encampment asterism — the omen matched that of the seventh month.

sentences.zh: 十一月丙戌，太白奄鉤钅句鈐。

translations.literal: On the bingxu day of the eleventh month Venus covered the Hooked Clasp.
translations.idiomatic: On a bingxu day in the eleventh month Venus eclipsed the Hooked Clasp asterism.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「喉舌臣憂。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "The spokesman ministers will suffer anxiety.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "The emperor's spokesmen will be afflicted with dread.

sentences.zh: 」十二月己卯，歲星犯天江。

translations.literal: " On the jimao day of the twelfth month Jupiter encroached on the Celestial River.
translations.idiomatic: " On a jimao day in the twelfth month Jupiter trespassed against the Celestial River asterism.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「有兵亂，河津不通。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "There will be armed chaos and river crossings will be blocked.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "Armed rebellion will erupt and the river fords will be cut off.

sentences.zh: 」是年六月，索頭寇沛土，使偽豫州刺史索度真戍相縣，太傅長沙景王討破走之。

translations.literal: " That year in the sixth month Suotou raided the Pei territories; he sent the false Inspector of Yuzhou Suo Duzhen to garrison Xiang county; the Grand Tutor, Prince of Changsha Jing, attacked, broke them, and put them to flight.
translations.idiomatic: " In the sixth month of that year the Tuoba chieftain (Suotou) invaded the Pei commandery, posting the puppet Inspector of Yuzhou Suo Duzhen at Xiang county; the Grand Tutor, Prince of Changsha Jing, routed the invaders and drove them off.

sentences.zh: 十一月，荊州刺史魏詠之薨。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month Wei Yongzhi, Governor of Jingzhou, passed away.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Wei Yongzhi, the Governor of Jingzhou, died.

sentences.zh: 二年二月，司馬國璠等攻沒弋陽。

translations.literal: In the second month of the second year Sima Guofan and others attacked and overran Yiyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the second year Sima Guofan and his allies captured Yiyang.

sentences.zh: 四月，羌伐仇池，仇池公楊盛擊走之。

translations.literal: In the fourth month the Qiang attacked Chouchi; the Lord of Chouchi Yang Sheng struck and put them to flight.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month Qiang forces attacked Chouchi; Yang Sheng, the Lord of Chouchi, beat them back.

sentences.zh: 九月，益州刺史司馬榮期為其參軍楊承祖所害，時文處茂討蜀屢有功，會榮期死，乃退。

translations.literal: In the ninth month Sima Rongqi, Governor of Yizhou, was killed by his staff officer Yang Chengzu; at the time Wen Chumao was campaigning against Shu with repeated success, but when Rongqi died he withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Sima Rongqi, the Governor of Yizhou, was murdered by his aide Yang Chengzu; Wen Chumao was then pressing the Shu campaign with repeated victories, but with Rongqi dead the army pulled back.

sentences.zh: 三年十二月，司徒揚州刺史王謐薨。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the third year Wang Mi, Minister over the Masses and Inspector of Yangzhou, passed away.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month of the third year Wang Mi, Minister over the Masses and Inspector of Yangzhou, died.

sentences.zh: 四年正月，太保武陵王遵薨。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fourth year Zun, Prince of Wuling and Grand Guardian, passed away.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the fourth year Zun, the Prince of Wuling and Grand Guardian, died.

sentences.zh: 三月，左僕射孔安國卒。

translations.literal: In the third month Kong Anguo, Left Vice Director, died.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month Kong Anguo, the Left Vice Director, died.

sentences.zh: 五年，高祖討鮮卑，並定舊兗之地。

translations.literal: In the fifth year Emperor Gaozu (Liu Yu) campaigned against the Xianbei and settled the former Yan territories.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year Emperor Gaozu (Liu Yu) marched against the Xianbei and restored the old Yan heartland to Jin rule.

sentences.zh: 義熙二年二月己醜，月犯心後星。

translations.literal: On the jichou day of the second month of the second year of Yiyuan the moon encroached on the posterior star of the Heart.
translations.idiomatic: On a jichou day in the second month of Yiyuan 2, the moon trespassed against the posterior star of the Heart asterism.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「豫州有災。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "Yuzhou will suffer calamity.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "Calamity will strike Yuzhou.

sentences.zh: 」四月癸醜，月犯太微西將。

translations.literal: " On the guichou day of the fourth month the moon encroached on the Western General of the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: " On a guichou day in the fourth month the moon trespassed against the Western General star of the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 己未，月犯房南第二星。

translations.literal: On the jiwei day the moon encroached on the second southern star of the Room.
translations.idiomatic: On a jiwei day the moon trespassed against the second southern star of the Room asterism.

sentences.zh: 乙丑，歲星犯天江，占悉同上。

translations.literal: On the yichou day Jupiter encroached on the Celestial River — all prognostications are the same as above.
translations.idiomatic: On a yichou day Jupiter trespassed against the Celestial River asterism — all omens were read as above.

sentences.zh: 五月癸未，月犯左角。

translations.literal: On the guiwei day of the fifth month the moon encroached on the Left Horn.
translations.idiomatic: On a guiwei day in the fifth month the moon trespassed against the Left Horn star.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「左將軍死，天下有兵。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "The General of the Left will die and armies will rise throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "The General of the Left will perish and war will erupt across the empire.

sentences.zh: 」壬寅，熒惑犯氐。

translations.literal: " On the renyin day Mars encroached on the Root.
translations.idiomatic: " On a renyin day Mars trespassed against the Root asterism.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「氐為宿宮，人主憂。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "The Root is the lodges palace; the ruler will suffer anxiety.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "The Root governs the ruler's dwelling; the sovereign will be gripped with dread.

sentences.zh: 」六月庚午，熒惑犯房北第二星。

translations.literal: " On the gengwu day of the sixth month Mars encroached on the second northern star of the Room.
translations.idiomatic: " On a gengwu day in the sixth month Mars trespassed against the second northern star of the Room asterism.

sentences.zh: 八月癸亥，熒惑犯鬥第五星。

translations.literal: On the guihai day of the eighth month Mars encroached on the fifth star of the Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: On a guihai day in the eighth month Mars trespassed against the fifth star of the Dipper asterism.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，犯建星。

translations.literal: On the dingsi day it encroached on the Building Star.
translations.idiomatic: On a dingsi day it trespassed against the Building Star.

sentences.zh: 九月壬午，熒惑犯哭星，又犯泣星，占悉同上。

translations.literal: On the renwu day of the ninth month Mars encroached on the Weeping Star and also encroached on the Crying Star — all prognostications are the same as above.
translations.idiomatic: On a renwu day in the ninth month Mars crossed the Weeping Star and then the Crying Star — all omens were read as above.

sentences.zh: 十二月丙午，月奄太白，在危。

translations.literal: On the bingwu day of the twelfth month the moon covered Venus in the Rooftop.
translations.idiomatic: On a bingwu day in the twelfth month the moon eclipsed Venus in the Rooftop asterism.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「齊亡國。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "Qi will perish as a state.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "The state of Qi will fall.

sentences.zh: 」一曰：「強國君死。

translations.literal: " Another reading says: "The ruler of a powerful state will die.
translations.idiomatic: " Another interpretation holds: "The lord of a great kingdom will perish.

sentences.zh: 」丁未，熒惑、太白皆入羽林。

translations.literal: " On the dingwei day both Mars and Venus entered the Forest of Spears.
translations.idiomatic: " On a dingwei day both Mars and Venus entered the Forest of Spears asterism.

sentences.zh: 是年二月甲戌，司馬國璠等攻沒弋陽。

translations.literal: On the jiaxu day of the second month of that year Sima Guofan and others attacked and overran Yiyang.
translations.idiomatic: On a jiaxu day in the second month of that year Sima Guofan and his allies captured Yiyang.

sentences.zh: 三年正月，鮮卑寇北徐州，至下邳。

translations.literal: In the first month of the third year the Xianbei raided Northern Xuzhou and reached Xiapi.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the third year the Xianbei struck Northern Xuzhou and pushed as far as Xiapi.

sentences.zh: 八月，遣劉敬宣伐蜀。

translations.literal: In the eighth month Liu Jingxuan was dispatched to campaign against Shu.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Liu Jingxuan was sent west against Shu.

sentences.zh: 十二月，司徒王謐薨。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month Wang Mi, Minister over the Masses, passed away.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Wang Mi, the Minister over the Masses, died.

sentences.zh: 四年正月，武陵王遵薨。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fourth year Zun, Prince of Wuling, passed away.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the fourth year Zun, the Prince of Wuling, died.

sentences.zh: 五年，鮮卑複寇淮北。

translations.literal: In the fifth year the Xianbei again raided the north of the Huai.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year the Xianbei again harried the lands north of the Huai.

sentences.zh: 四月，高祖大軍討之。

translations.literal: In the fourth month Emperor Gaozu's great army campaigned against them.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month Emperor Gaozu marched in force against them.

sentences.zh: 六月，大戰臨朐城，進圍廣固。

translations.literal: In the sixth month a great battle was fought at Linqu city; they advanced and besieged Guanggu.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month the armies clashed in a great battle at Linqu and then pressed on to besiege Guanggu.

sentences.zh: 十月，什圭為其子偽清河公所殺。

translations.literal: In the tenth month Shigui was killed by his son, the false Duke of Qinghe.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Tuoba Gui (Shigui) was slain by his own son, the puppet Duke of Qinghe.

sentences.zh: 六年二月，拔廣固，禽慕容超，坑斬其眾三千餘人。

translations.literal: In the second month of the sixth year Guanggu was taken; Murong Chao was captured; more than three thousand of his followers were buried alive and beheaded.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the sixth year Guanggu fell; Murong Chao was taken alive; more than three thousand of his followers were buried alive or beheaded.

sentences.zh: 義熙三年正月丙子，太白晝見，在奎。

translations.literal: On the bingzi day of the first month of the third year of Yiyuan Venus was visible in daylight in the Legs.
translations.idiomatic: On a bingzi day in the first month of Yiyuan 3, Venus shone by day in the Legs asterism.

sentences.zh: 二月庚寅，月奄心後星，占悉同上。

translations.literal: On the gengyin day the moon covered the posterior star of the Heart — all prognostications are the same as above.
translations.idiomatic: On a gengyin day the moon eclipsed the posterior star of the Heart asterism — all omens were read as above.

sentences.zh: 癸亥，熒惑、填星、太白、辰星聚于奎、婁，從填星也。

translations.literal: On the guihai day Mars, Saturn, Venus, and Mercury gathered at Kui and Bond, following Saturn.
translations.idiomatic: On a guihai day Mars, Saturn, Venus, and Mercury converged in the Kui and Bond asterisms, trailing Saturn's lead.

sentences.zh: 其說見上九年。

translations.literal: The explanation is given above under the ninth year.
translations.idiomatic: The interpretation is set forth above, in the entry for the ninth year.

sentences.zh: 五月己醜，太白晝見，在參。

translations.literal: On the jichou day of the fifth month Venus was visible in daylight in the Triaster.
translations.idiomatic: On a jichou day in the fifth month Venus shone by day in the Triaster asterism.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「益州有兵喪，臣強。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "Yizhou will have war and mourning; the ministers will be strong.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "Yizhou will know war and death in arms, and the ministers will grow powerful.

sentences.zh: 」六月辛卯，熒惑犯辰星，在翼。

translations.literal: " On the xinmao day of the sixth month Mars encroached on Mercury in the Wings.
translations.idiomatic: " On a xinmao day in the sixth month Mars trespassed against Mercury in the Wings asterism.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「天下兵起。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "Armies will rise throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "War will break out across the empire.

sentences.zh: 」八月己卯，太白奄熒惑，又犯執法。

translations.literal: " On the jimao day of the eighth month Venus covered Mars and also encroached on the Law Enforcer.
translations.idiomatic: " On a jimao day in the eighth month Venus eclipsed Mars and also trespassed against the Law Enforcer star.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「奄熒惑，有大兵。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "When one star covers Mars, there will be great armies.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "When a star eclipses Mars, war will erupt on a vast scale.

sentences.zh: 」辛卯，熒惑犯左執法。

translations.literal: " On the xinmao day Mars encroached on the Left Law Enforcer.
translations.idiomatic: " On a xinmao day Mars trespassed against the Left Law Enforcer star.

sentences.zh: 九月壬子，熒惑犯進腎。

translations.literal: On the renzi day of the ninth month Mars encroached on the Advance Kidney.
translations.idiomatic: On a renzi day in the ninth month Mars trespassed against the Advance Kidney star.

sentences.zh: 是年正月丁巳，鮮卑寇北徐，至下邳。

translations.literal: On the dingsi day of the first month of that year the Xianbei raided Northern Xu and reached Xiapi.
translations.idiomatic: On a dingsi day in the first month of that year the Xianbei invaded Northern Xuzhou and advanced to Xiapi.

sentences.zh: 八月，劉敬宣伐蜀，不克而旋。

translations.literal: In the eighth month Liu Jingxuan campaigned against Shu but failed to conquer and returned.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Liu Jingxuan's expedition against Shu failed, and he withdrew without victory.

sentences.zh: 四年三月，左僕射孔安國卒。

translations.literal: In the third month of the fourth year Kong Anguo, Left Vice Director, died.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the fourth year Kong Anguo, the Left Vice Director, died.

sentences.zh: 七月，司馬國璠等攻沒鄒山，魯郡太守徐邕破走之。

translations.literal: In the seventh month Sima Guofan and others attacked and overran Zou Mountain; Xu Yong, Administrator of Lu commandery, broke and put them to flight.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month Sima Guofan and his allies overran Mount Zou; Xu Yong, the Administrator of Lu, routed them and drove them away.

sentences.zh: 姚略遣眾征佛佛，大為所破。

translations.literal: Yao Lue dispatched troops to campaign against Fofo and was heavily defeated by him.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Lue sent an army against Helian Bobo (Fofo) and was shattered in return.

sentences.zh: 五年，高祖討鮮卑。

translations.literal: In the fifth year Emperor Gaozu (Liu Yu) campaigned against the Xianbei.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year Emperor Gaozu (Liu Yu) marched against the Xianbei.

sentences.zh: 六年三月，妖賊徐道覆殺鎮南將軍、江州刺史何無忌于豫章。

translations.literal: In the third month of the sixth year the rebel Xu Daofu killed He Wuji, General Who Guards the South and Inspector of Jiangzhou, at Yuzhang.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the sixth year the rebel Xu Daofu murdered He Wuji — General Who Guards the South and Inspector of Jiangzhou — at Yuzhang.

sentences.zh: 四月，妖賊盧循寇湘中巴陵。

translations.literal: In the fourth month the rebel Lu Xun raided Balin in Xiang commandery.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month the rebel Lu Xun struck at Balin in Xiang commandery.

sentences.zh: 五月丙子，循、道覆敗撫軍將軍、豫州刺史劉毅于桑落洲，毅僅以身免。

translations.literal: On the bingzi day of the fifth month Xun and Daofu defeated Liu Yi, General Who Pacifies the Army and Inspector of Yuzhou, at Sangluo Isle; Yi barely escaped with his life.
translations.idiomatic: On a bingzi day in the fifth month Lu Xun and Xu Daofu crushed Liu Yi, General Who Pacifies the Army and Inspector of Yuzhou, at Sangluo Isle; Yi escaped with little more than his life.

sentences.zh: 丁醜，循等至蔡洲，遣別將焚京口。

translations.literal: On the dingchou day Xun and the others reached Cai Isle and dispatched a separate commander to burn Jingkou.
translations.idiomatic: On a dingchou day the rebels reached Cai Isle and sent a detached force to burn Jingkou.

sentences.zh: 庚辰，賊攻焚查浦，查浦戍將距戰不利，高祖遣軍渡淮擊，大破之。

translations.literal: On the gengchen day the rebels attacked and burned Chapu; the garrison commander at Chapu resisted but fared poorly; Emperor Gaozu sent troops across the Huai to strike and inflicted a great defeat.
translations.idiomatic: On a gengchen day the rebels stormed and burned Chapu; its garrison fought but could not hold; Emperor Gaozu sent troops across the Huai and broke them decisively.

sentences.zh: 司馬國璠寇碭山，竺夔討破之。

translations.literal: Sima Guofan raided Mount Dang; Zhu Kui attacked and broke him.
translations.idiomatic: Sima Guofan raided Mount Dang; Zhu Kui struck back and routed him.

sentences.zh: 七月，妖賊南走據尋陽，高祖遣劉鐘等追之。

translations.literal: In the seventh month the rebel armies fled south and held Xunyang; Emperor Gaozu dispatched Liu Zhong and others in pursuit.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month the rebel hosts withdrew south to hold Xunyang; Emperor Gaozu sent Liu Zhong and others in pursuit.

sentences.zh: 八月，孫季高乘海伐廣州。

translations.literal: In the eighth month Sun Jigao sailed by sea to campaign against Guangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Sun Jigao put to sea against Guangzhou.

sentences.zh: 桓謙以蜀眾聚枝江，盧循將荀林略華容，相去百里。

translations.literal: Huan Qian assembled his Shu troops at Zhijiang; Xun Lin, Lu Xun's general, raided Huarong; they stood a hundred li apart.
translations.idiomatic: Huan Qian gathered his Shu contingents at Zhijiang while Lu Xun's commander Xun Lin overran Huarong — the two forces lay a hundred li apart.

sentences.zh: 臨川烈武王討謙之，又討林，林退走。

translations.literal: The Prince of Linchuan Lie Wu attacked Qian and then attacked Lin; Lin retreated and fled.
translations.idiomatic: The Prince of Linchuan Lie Wu struck at Huan Qian and then at Xun Lin; Lin broke and fled.

sentences.zh: 鄱陽太守虞丘進破賊別帥于上饒。

translations.literal: Yu Qiu Jin, Administrator of Poyang, broke a rebel sub-commander at Shangrao.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Qiu Jin, the Administrator of Poyang, routed a rebel lieutenant at Shangrao.

sentences.zh: 九月，烈武王使劉遵擊荀林于巴陵，斬之。

translations.literal: In the ninth month the Prince of Linchuan Lie Wu had Liu Zun strike Xun Lin at Balin and behead him.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month the Prince of Linchuan Lie Wu sent Liu Zun against Xun Lin at Balin and had him beheaded.

sentences.zh: 桓道兒率蔡猛向大薄，又遣劉基討之，斬猛。

translations.literal: Huan Dao'er led Cai Meng toward Dabo; Liu Ji was again dispatched to campaign against them and beheaded Meng.
translations.idiomatic: Huan Dao'er led Cai Meng toward Dabo; Liu Ji was sent against them again and struck Meng down.

sentences.zh: 十月，高祖以舟師南征。

translations.literal: In the tenth month Emperor Gaozu led a naval force south on campaign.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month Emperor Gaozu sailed south at the head of a fleet.

sentences.zh: 是時徐道覆率二萬餘人攻荊州，烈武王距之。

translations.literal: At that time Xu Daofu led more than twenty thousand men to attack Jingzhou; the Prince of Linchuan Lie Wu resisted them.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Xu Daofu led more than twenty thousand men against Jingzhou; the Prince of Linchuan Lie Wu met him in the field.

sentences.zh: 戰於江津，大破之，梟殄其十八九。

translations.literal: They fought at the Jiangjin crossing, inflicted a great defeat, and beheaded and destroyed eight or nine tenths of the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: At the Jiangjin crossing they fought a great battle, shattered the rebel host, and slaughtered eight or nine men in ten.

sentences.zh: 道覆棄戰船走。

translations.literal: Xu Daofu abandoned his warships and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Daofu abandoned his war-junks and took flight.

sentences.zh: 十一月，劉鐘破賊軍于南陵。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month Liu Zhong broke the rebel army at Nanling.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month Liu Zhong routed the rebels at Nanling.

sentences.zh: 癸醜，益州刺史鮑陋卒于白帝，譙道福攻沒其眾。

translations.literal: On the guichou day Bao Lou, Governor of Yizhou, died at Baidi; Qiao Daofu attacked and overran his troops.
translations.idiomatic: On a guichou day Bao Lou, the Governor of Yizhou, died at Baidi; Qiao Daofu struck, overran his force, and absorbed his men.

sentences.zh: 庚戌，孫季高襲廣州，克之。

translations.literal: On the gengxu day Sun Jigao made a surprise attack on Guangzhou and captured it.
translations.idiomatic: On a gengxu day Sun Jigao stormed Guangzhou by surprise and took the city.

sentences.zh: 十二月，高祖在大雷，與賊交戰，大破之。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month Emperor Gaozu was at Dalei, joined battle with the rebels, and inflicted a great defeat.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, at Dalei, Emperor Gaozu met the rebels in battle and broke them decisively.

sentences.zh: 賊走左裏，進擊，又破，死者十八九。

translations.literal: The rebels fled toward Zuoli; pursuing them, he again broke them, and eight or nine tenths of them died.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels fled toward Zuoli; a pursuit shattered them again, and eight or nine men in ten perished.

sentences.zh: 賊還廣州，劉籓等追之。

translations.literal: The rebels returned to Guangzhou; Liu Fan and others pursued them.
translations.idiomatic: The rebels withdrew to Guangzhou; Liu Fan and others pressed the pursuit.

sentences.zh: 七年二月，籓拔始興城，斬徐道覆、盧循還番禺，攻圍孫季高，不能克。

translations.literal: In the second month of the seventh year Fan took Shixing city and beheaded Xu Daofu; Lu Xun returned to Panyu, besieged Sun Jigao, and could not capture him.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the seventh year Liu Fan stormed Shixing and struck off Xu Daofu's head; Lu Xun fell back on Panyu, besieged Sun Jigao, but failed to take him.

sentences.zh: 走交州，交州刺史杜慧度斬之。

translations.literal: Fleeing toward Jiaozhou, he was beheaded by Du Huidu, Governor of Jiaozhou.
translations.idiomatic: He fled toward Jiaozhou; Du Huidu, the Governor of Jiaozhou, tracked him down and killed him.

sentences.zh: 四月，到彥之攻譙道福于白帝，拔之。

translations.literal: In the fourth month Dao Yanzhi attacked Qiao Daofu at Baidi and captured the place.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month Dao Yanzhi besieged Qiao Daofu at Baidi and took the city.

sentences.zh: 義熙四年正月庚子，熒惑犯天江，占同上。

translations.literal: On the gengzi day of the first month of the fourth year of Yiyuan Mars encroached on the Celestial River — the prognostication is the same as above.
translations.idiomatic: On a gengzi day in the first month of Yiyuan 4, Mars trespassed against the Celestial River asterism — the omen was read as above.

sentences.zh: 五月丁未，月奄鬥第二星，占同上。

translations.literal: On the dingwei day of the fifth month the moon covered the second star of the Dipper — the prognostication is the same as above.
translations.idiomatic: On a dingwei day in the fifth month the moon eclipsed the second star of the Dipper asterism — the omen was read as above.

sentences.zh: 壬子，填星犯天廩。

translations.literal: On the renzi day Saturn encroached on the Celestial Granary.
translations.idiomatic: On a renzi day Saturn trespassed against the Celestial Granary asterism.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「天下饑，倉粟少。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "The realm will suffer famine and granary stores will be few.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "Famine will stalk the land and the granaries will run low.

sentences.zh: 」六月己醜，太白犯太微西上將。

translations.literal: " On the jichou day of the sixth month Venus encroached on the Western Senior General star of the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: " On a jichou day in the sixth month Venus trespassed against the Western Senior General star of the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 己卯，又犯左執法。

translations.literal: On the jimao day it again encroached on the Left Law Enforcer.
translations.idiomatic: On a jimao day it trespassed against the Left Law Enforcer star again.

sentences.zh: 十月戊子，熒惑入羽林。

translations.literal: On the wuzi day of the tenth month Mars entered the Forest of Spears.
translations.idiomatic: On a wuzi day in the tenth month Mars entered the Forest of Spears asterism.

sentences.zh: 占悉同上。

translations.literal: All prognostications are the same as above.
translations.idiomatic: All omens were read as above.

sentences.zh: 五年，高祖討鮮卑。

translations.literal: In the fifth year Emperor Gaozu (Liu Yu) campaigned against the Xianbei.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year Emperor Gaozu (Liu Yu) marched against the Xianbei.

sentences.zh: 六年，左僕射孟昶仰藥卒。

translations.literal: In the sixth year Meng Chang, Left Vice Director, took poison and died.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year Meng Chang, the Left Vice Director, drank poison and died.

sentences.zh: 是後南北軍旅，運轉不息。

translations.literal: Thereafter northern and southern armies marched without ceasing.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter armies shuttled north and south without rest.

sentences.zh: 義熙六年三月丁卯，月奄房南第二星。

translations.literal: On the dingmao day of the third month of the sixth year of Yiyuan the moon covered the second southern star of the Room.
translations.idiomatic: On a dingmao day in the third month of Yiyuan 6, the moon eclipsed the second southern star of the Room asterism.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「災在次相。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "Calamity lies with the secondary minister.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "Disaster will strike the second-ranking minister.

sentences.zh: 」己巳，又奄鬥第五星。

translations.literal: " On the jisi day it again covered the fifth star of the Dipper.
translations.idiomatic: " On a jisi day it eclipsed the fifth star of the Dipper asterism again.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「鬥主兵，兵起。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "The Dipper governs armies; armies will rise.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "The Dipper presides over war — armies will mobilize.

sentences.zh: 」一曰：「將軍死。

translations.literal: " Another reading says: "A general will die.
translations.idiomatic: " Another interpretation holds: "A general will perish.

sentences.zh: 」太白犯五諸侯。

translations.literal: " Venus encroached on the Five Feudal Lords.
translations.idiomatic: " Venus trespassed against the Five Feudal Lords asterism.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「諸侯有誅。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "Feudal lords will be executed.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "Regional lords will be put to death.

sentences.zh: 」五月甲子，月奄鬥第五星，占同三月。

translations.literal: " On the jiazi day of the fifth month the moon covered the fifth star of the Dipper — the prognostication is the same as in the third month.
translations.idiomatic: " On a jiazi day in the fifth month the moon eclipsed the fifth star of the Dipper asterism — the omen was read as in the third month.

sentences.zh: 己亥，月奄昴。

translations.literal: On the jihai day the moon covered the Hairy Head.
translations.idiomatic: On a jihai day the moon eclipsed the Hairy Head asterism.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「國有憂。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "The state will have cause for anxiety.
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "The realm will face grave concern.

sentences.zh: 」一曰：「有白衣之會。

translations.literal: " Another reading says: "There will be a white-robed assembly.
translations.idiomatic: " Another interpretation holds: "There will be a gathering in white.

sentences.zh: 」六月己醜，月犯房南第二星。

translations.literal: " On the jichou day of the sixth month the moon encroached on the second southern star of the Room.
translations.idiomatic: " On a jichou day in the sixth month the moon trespassed against the second southern star of the Room asterism.

sentences.zh: 甲午，太白晝見，占並同上。

translations.literal: On the jiawu day Venus was visible in daylight — all prognostications are the same as above.
translations.idiomatic: On a jiawu day Venus shone by day — all omens were read as above.

sentences.zh: 七月己亥，月犯輿鬼。

translations.literal: On the jihai day of the seventh month the moon encroached on the Celestial Cart and Ghost.
translations.idiomatic: On a jihai day in the seventh month the moon trespassed against the Celestial Cart and Ghost asterism.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「國有憂。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "The state will have cause for anxiety.
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "The realm will face grave concern.

sentences.zh: 」一曰：「秦有兵。

translations.literal: " Another reading says: "Qin will have armies.
translations.idiomatic: " Another interpretation holds: "Qin will go to war.

sentences.zh: 」八月壬午，太白犯軒轅大星。

translations.literal: " On the renwu day of the eighth month Venus encroached on the great star of Xuanyuan.
translations.idiomatic: " On a renwu day in the eighth month Venus crossed the chief star of Xuanyuan.

sentences.zh: 甲申，月犯心前星。

translations.literal: On the jiashen day the moon encroached on the anterior star of the Heart.
translations.idiomatic: On a jiashen day the moon trespassed against the anterior star of the Heart asterism.

sentences.zh: 災在豫州。

translations.literal: Calamity lay in Yuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Disaster would fall upon Yuzhou.

sentences.zh: 丙戌，月犯鬥第五星，占悉同上五月。

translations.literal: On the bingxu day the moon encroached on the fifth star of the Dipper — all prognostications are the same as in the fifth month.
translations.idiomatic: On a bingxu day the moon trespassed against the fifth star of the Dipper asterism — all omens were read as in the fifth month.

sentences.zh: 丁亥，月奄牛宿南星。

translations.literal: On the dinghai day the moon covered the southern star of Leading Ox.
translations.idiomatic: On a dinghai day the moon eclipsed the southern star of the Leading Ox asterism.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「天下有大誅。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "There will be great executions throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "Mass executions will sweep the empire.

sentences.zh: 」乙未，太白犯少微。

translations.literal: " On the yiwei day Venus encroached on the Lesser Supreme Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: " On a yiwei day Venus trespassed against the Lesser Supreme Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 丙午，太白在少微而晝見。

translations.literal: On the bingwu day Venus was in the Lesser Supreme Enclosure and visible in daylight.
translations.idiomatic: On a bingwu day Venus stood in the Lesser Supreme Enclosure and shone by day.

sentences.zh: 九月甲寅，太白犯左執法。

translations.literal: On the jiayin day of the ninth month Venus encroached on the Left Law Enforcer.
translations.idiomatic: On a jiayin day in the ninth month Venus trespassed against the Left Law Enforcer star.

sentences.zh: 丁醜，填星犯畢。

translations.literal: On the dingchou day Saturn encroached on the Net.
translations.idiomatic: On a dingchou day Saturn trespassed against the Net asterism.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「有邊兵。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "There will be border armies.
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "Armies would stir on the frontier.

sentences.zh: 」是年三月，始興太守徐道覆反，江州刺史何無忌討之，大敗于豫章，無忌死之。

translations.literal: " That year in the third month Xu Daofu, Administrator of Shixing, rebelled; He Wuji, Governor of Jiangzhou, campaigned against him and was heavily defeated at Yuzhang; Wuji died.
translations.idiomatic: " In the third month of that year Xu Daofu, the Administrator of Shixing, rose in rebellion; He Wuji, the Governor of Jiangzhou, marched against him but was crushed at Yuzhang, where he was killed.

sentences.zh: 四月，盧循寇湘中，沒巴陵。

translations.literal: In the fourth month Lu Xun raided Xiang commandery and overran Balin.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month Lu Xun harried the Xiang region and captured Balin.

sentences.zh: 五月，循等大破豫州刺史劉毅，毅僅以身免；

translations.literal: In the fifth month Xun and others heavily defeated Liu Yi, Inspector of Yuzhou; Yi barely escaped with his life.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Lu Xun and his allies shattered Liu Yi, the Inspector of Yuzhou; Yi escaped with little more than his life.

sentences.zh: 循率眾逼京畿。

translations.literal: Xun led his troops to press upon the capital region.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Xun then drove his host toward the capital.

sentences.zh: 是月，左僕射孟昶懼王威不振，仰藥自殺。

translations.literal: That month Meng Chang, Left Vice Director, fearing the royal authority was not strong, took poison and killed himself.
translations.idiomatic: That same month Meng Chang, the Left Vice Director, fearing that imperial authority had waned, drank poison and took his own life.

sentences.zh: 七年二月，劉籓梟徐道覆首，杜慧度斬盧循，並傳首京都。

translations.literal: In the second month of the seventh year Liu Fan displayed Xu Daofu's severed head; Du Huidu beheaded Lu Xun — both sent their heads to the capital.
translations.idiomatic: In the second month of the seventh year Liu Fan had Xu Daofu's head displayed on a pole; Du Huidu struck down Lu Xun — both heads were sent to the capital.

sentences.zh: 八年六月，臨川烈武王道規薨，時為豫州。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the eighth year Daogui, Prince of Linchuan Lie Wu, passed away; at the time he was Governor of Yuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the eighth year Daogui, the Prince of Linchuan Lie Wu, died while serving as Governor of Yuzhou.

sentences.zh: 八月，皇后王氏崩。

translations.literal: In the eighth month Empress Wang passed away.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Empress Wang died.

sentences.zh: 九月，兗州刺史劉籓、尚書僕射謝混伏誅。

translations.literal: In the ninth month Liu Fan, Inspector of Yanzhou, and Xie Hun, Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, were executed at court.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Liu Fan, the Inspector of Yanzhou, and Xie Hun, the Vice Director of the Masters of Writing, were put to death.

sentences.zh: 高祖西討劉毅，斬之。

translations.literal: Emperor Gaozu campaigned west against Liu Yi and beheaded him.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Gaozu marched west against Liu Yi and struck him down.

sentences.zh: 十二月，遣益州刺史硃齡石伐蜀。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month he dispatched Zhu Lingshi, Governor of Yizhou, to campaign against Shu.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month he sent Zhu Lingshi, the Governor of Yizhou, to invade Shu.

sentences.zh: 九年，諸葛長民伏誅。

translations.literal: In the ninth year Zhuge Changmin was executed at court.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year Zhuge Changmin was put to death.

sentences.zh: 林邑王范胡達將萬餘人寇九真，九真太守杜彗期距破之。

translations.literal: Fan Huda, King of Linyi, led more than ten thousand men to raid Jiuzhen; Du Huiqi, Administrator of Jiuzhen, resisted and broke him.
translations.idiomatic: Fan Huda, the King of Linyi, led more than ten thousand men against Jiuzhen; Du Huiqi, the Administrator of Jiuzhen, met him in the field and routed him.

sentences.zh: 七月，硃齡石滅蜀。

translations.literal: In the seventh month Zhu Lingshi destroyed Shu.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month Zhu Lingshi conquered Shu.

sentences.zh: 義熙八年正月庚戌，月犯歲星，在畢，占同上。

translations.literal: On the gengxu day of the first month of the eighth year of Yiyuan the moon encroached on Jupiter in the Net — the prognostication is the same as above.
translations.idiomatic: On a gengxu day in the first month of Yiyuan 8, the moon trespassed against Jupiter in the Net asterism — the omen was read as above.

sentences.zh: 七月癸亥，月奄房北第二星，占同上。

translations.literal: On the guihai day of the seventh month the moon covered the second northern star of the Room — the prognostication is the same as above.
translations.idiomatic: On a guihai day in the seventh month the moon eclipsed the second northern star of the Room asterism — the omen was read as above.

sentences.zh: 甲申，太白犯填星，在東井。

translations.literal: On the jiashen day Venus encroached on Saturn in the Eastern Well.
translations.idiomatic: On a jiashen day Venus trespassed against Saturn in the Eastern Well asterism.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「秦有大兵。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "Qin will have great armies.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "Qin will mobilize on a great scale.

sentences.zh: 」己未，月犯井鉞。

translations.literal: " On the jiwei day the moon encroached on the Well Axe.
translations.idiomatic: " On a jiwei day the moon trespassed against the Well Axe star.

sentences.zh: 八月戊申，月犯泣星。

translations.literal: On the wushen day of the eighth month the moon encroached on the Weeping Star.
translations.idiomatic: On a wushen day in the eighth month the moon trespassed against the Weeping Star.

sentences.zh: 十月辛亥，月奄天關。

translations.literal: On the xinhai day of the tenth month the moon covered the Celestial Gate.
translations.idiomatic: On a xinhai day in the tenth month the moon eclipsed the Celestial Gate star.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「有兵。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "There will be armies.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "War will break out.

sentences.zh: 」十月丁醜，填星犯東井。

translations.literal: " On the dingchou day of the tenth month Saturn encroached on the Eastern Well.
translations.idiomatic: " On a dingchou day in the tenth month Saturn trespassed against the Eastern Well asterism.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「大人憂。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "Great men will be troubled.
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "The mighty would grieve.

sentences.zh: 」十二月癸卯，填星犯井鉞。

translations.literal: " On the guimao day of the twelfth month Saturn encroached on the Well Axe.
translations.idiomatic: " On a guimao day in the twelfth month Saturn trespassed against the Well Axe star.

sentences.zh: 是年八月，皇后王氏崩。

translations.literal: In the eighth month of that year Empress Wang passed away.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of that year Empress Wang died.

sentences.zh: 九月，誅劉籓、謝混，滅劉毅。

translations.literal: In the ninth month Liu Fan and Xie Hun were executed and Liu Yi was destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Liu Fan and Xie Hun were put to death and Liu Yi was wiped out.

sentences.zh: 九年三月，誅諸葛長民。

translations.literal: In the third month of the ninth year Zhuge Changmin was executed.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the ninth year Zhuge Changmin was put to death.

sentences.zh: 西虜攻羌安定戍，克之。

translations.literal: The Western barbarians attacked the Qiang garrison at Anding and captured it.
translations.idiomatic: Western barbarian forces stormed the Qiang garrison at Anding and took it.

sentences.zh: 十二月，硃齡石伐蜀。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month Zhu Lingshi campaigned against Shu.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Zhu Lingshi invaded Shu.

sentences.zh: 九年七月，硃齡石滅蜀。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the ninth year Zhu Lingshi destroyed Shu.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the ninth year Zhu Lingshi conquered Shu.

sentences.zh: 義熙九年二月丙午，熒惑、填星皆犯東井。

translations.literal: On the bingwu day of the second month of the ninth year of Yiyuan Mars and Saturn both encroached on the Eastern Well.
translations.idiomatic: On a bingwu day in the second month of Yiyuan 9, Mars and Saturn both trespassed against the Eastern Well asterism.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「秦有兵。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "Qin will have armies.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "Qin will go to war.

sentences.zh: 」壬辰，歲星、熒惑、填星、太白聚于東井，從歲星也。

translations.literal: " On the renchen day Jupiter, Mars, Saturn, and Venus gathered at the Eastern Well, following Jupiter.
translations.idiomatic: " On a renchen day Jupiter, Mars, Saturn, and Venus converged in the Eastern Well asterism, trailing Jupiter's lead.

sentences.zh: 熒惑入輿鬼，太白犯南河。

translations.literal: Mars entered the Celestial Cart and Ghost; Venus encroached on the Southern River.
translations.idiomatic: Mars entered the Celestial Cart and Ghost asterism; Venus trespassed against the Southern River.

sentences.zh: 初，義熙三年，四星聚奎，奎、婁，徐州分。

translations.literal: Earlier, in the third year of Yiyuan four stars gathered at Kui; Kui and Bond are the allotment of Xuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, in Yiyuan 3, four planets converged at the Kui asterism; Kui and Bond govern the territory of Xuzhou.

sentences.zh: 是時慕容超僭號于齊，侵略徐、兗，連歲寇抄，至於淮、泗。

translations.literal: At that time Murong Chao arrogantly assumed a reign title in Qi, invaded Xu and Yan, and raided year after year as far as the Huai and Si.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Murong Chao had usurped a royal title in Qi and harried Xu and Yan, raiding year after year as far as the Huai and Si rivers.

sentences.zh: 姚興、譙縱僭偽秦、蜀。

translations.literal: Yao Xing and Qiao Zong pretended to realms of false Qin and Shu.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Xing and Qiao Zong had set up puppet states of Qin and Shu.

sentences.zh: 盧循、木末，南北交侵。

translations.literal: Lu Xun and Mumu invaded from north and south in turn.
translations.idiomatic: Lu Xun and Helian Bobo (Mumu) pressed in from south and north alike.

sentences.zh: 五年，高祖北殄鮮卑，是四星聚奎之應也。

translations.literal: In the fifth year Emperor Gaozu exterminated the Xianbei in the north — this was the fulfillment of the gathering of four stars at Kui.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year Emperor Gaozu annihilated the Xianbei in the north — the fulfillment of the four-planet convergence at Kui.

sentences.zh: 九年，又聚東井。

translations.literal: In the ninth year they gathered again at the Eastern Well.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year the planets converged again at the Eastern Well.

sentences.zh: 東井，秦分。

translations.literal: The Eastern Well is the allotment of Qin.
translations.idiomatic: The Eastern Well asterism governs the territory of Qin.

sentences.zh: 十三年，高祖定關中，又其應也。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year Emperor Gaozu settled the Guanzhong — this too was its fulfillment.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year Emperor Gaozu pacified the Guanzhong region — another fulfillment of the omen.

sentences.zh: 而縱、循群凶之徒，皆己剪滅，於是天人歸望，建國舊徐。

translations.literal: Meanwhile the wicked such as Zong and Xun had already been cut down; Heaven and men turned their hearts, and the state was founded in old Xu.
translations.idiomatic: By then the ringleaders Zong, Xun, and their ilk had all been destroyed; Heaven and men alike looked to a new ruler, and the dynasty was founded in the old Xu territories.

sentences.zh: 元熙二年，受終納禪，皆其征也。

translations.literal: In the second year of Yuanxi he received the final transfer and accepted the abdication — all of these were its signs.
translations.idiomatic: In Yuanxi 2 he received the abdication and took the throne — all of this was the omen's fulfillment.

sentences.zh: 《星傳》曰：「四星若合，是謂太陽，其國兵喪並起，君子憂，小人流。

translations.literal: The Treatise on Stars says: "When four stars combine, this is called the Supreme Yang; in that state war and mourning will rise together, gentlemen will be troubled, and petty men will drift.
translations.idiomatic: The Treatise on Stars explains: "When four stars unite, the pattern is called Supreme Yang — war and death in arms together afflict the realm, the worthy grieve, and the base scatter.

sentences.zh: 五星若合，是謂易行。

translations.literal: When five stars combine, this is called Changing Motion.
translations.idiomatic: When five stars unite, the pattern is called Changing Motion.

sentences.zh: 有德受慶，改立王者，奄有四方；

translations.literal: With virtue one receives blessing, establishes a new king, and covers the four quarters;
translations.idiomatic: The virtuous receive blessing, a new sovereign is raised, and all four quarters are possessed;

sentences.zh: 無德受罰，離其國家，滅其宗廟。

translations.literal: without virtue one receives punishment, loses state and family, and ancestral temples are destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: the unvirtuous suffer punishment — realm lost, ancestral shrines razed.

sentences.zh: 」今案遺文所存，五星聚者有三：周漢以王齊以霸，周將伐殷，五星聚房。

translations.literal: " Examining the surviving records, there are three gatherings of five stars: Zhou and Han became kings, Qi became hegemon — when Zhou was about to attack Yin, five stars gathered at the Room.
translations.idiomatic: " Surveying the texts that survive, three cases of five-star convergences stand out: Zhou and Han won kingship, Qi won hegemony — as the Zhou house prepared to attack Yin, five stars converged at the Room asterism.

sentences.zh: 齊桓將霸，五星聚箕。

translations.literal: When Duke Huan of Qi was about to become hegemon, five stars gathered at the Winnower.
translations.idiomatic: When Duke Huan of Qi was rising to hegemony, five stars converged at the Winnower asterism.

sentences.zh: 漢高入秦，五星聚東井。

translations.literal: When Gaozu of Han entered Qin, five stars gathered at the Eastern Well.
translations.idiomatic: When the Han Founder entered Qin, five stars converged at the Eastern Well asterism.

sentences.zh: 齊則永終侯伯，卒無更紀之事。

translations.literal: As for Qi, it ended forever as marquis or earl and ultimately had no affair of changing the era.
translations.idiomatic: Qi, however, remained only a hegemon and never changed the dynastic age — no case of Changing Motion at all.

sentences.zh: 是則五星聚有不易行者矣。

translations.literal: Thus among gatherings of five stars there are those that do not involve Changing Motion.
translations.idiomatic: Thus among five-star convergences there are cases that never involve Changing Motion.

sentences.zh: 四星聚者有九：漢光武、晉元帝並中興，而魏、宋並更紀。

translations.literal: Gatherings of four stars number nine: Guangwu of Han and Emperor Yuan of Jin both restored the dynasty, while Wei and Song both changed the era.
translations.idiomatic: Nine instances of four-star convergence are recorded: Guangwu of Han and Emperor Yuan of Jin both revived fallen dynasties, while Wei and Song both ushered in new reign eras.

sentences.zh: 是則四星聚有以易行者矣。

translations.literal: Thus among gatherings of four stars there are those that do involve Changing Motion.
translations.idiomatic: Thus among four-star convergences there are cases of Changing Motion after all.

sentences.zh: 昔漢平帝元始四年，四星聚柳、張，各五日。

translations.literal: Formerly in the fourth year of Yuanshi under Emperor Ping of Han, four stars gathered at Willow and Extended Net, each for five days.
translations.idiomatic: In Yuanshi 4 of Emperor Ping of Han, four planets converged at the Willow and Extended Net asterisms, lingering five days apiece.

sentences.zh: 柳、張，三河分。

translations.literal: Willow and Extended Net are the allotment of the Three Rivers.
translations.idiomatic: The Willow and Extended Net asterisms govern the Three Rivers region.

sentences.zh: 後有王莽、赤眉之亂，而光武興複於洛。

translations.literal: Later there were the disorders of Wang Mang and the Red Eyebrows, and Guangwu revived the dynasty at Luo.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter came the turmoil of Wang Mang and the Red Eyebrows, and Guangwu restored the Han at Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 晉懷帝永嘉六年，四星聚牛、女，後有劉聰、石勒之亂，而元皇興複揚土。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Yongjia under Emperor Huai of Jin, four stars gathered at Ox and Maiden; later came the disorders of Liu Cong and Shi Le, and Emperor Yuan revived the dynasty in the Yang lands.
translations.idiomatic: In Yongjia 6 of Emperor Huai of Jin, four planets converged at the Ox and Maiden asterisms; later Liu Cong and Shi Le ravaged the realm, and Emperor Yuan restored order in the Yang region.

sentences.zh: 漢獻帝初平元年，四星聚心，又聚箕、尾。

translations.literal: In the first year of Chuping under Emperor Xian of Han, four stars gathered at the Heart, and again gathered at Winnower and Tail.
translations.idiomatic: In Chuping 1 of Emperor Xian of Han, four planets converged at the Heart asterism, then again at the Winnower and Tail.

sentences.zh: 心，豫州分。

translations.literal: The Heart is the allotment of Yuzhou.
translations.idiomatic: The Heart asterism governs the territory of Yuzhou.

sentences.zh: 後有董卓、李傕暴亂，黃巾、黑山熾擾，而魏武迎帝都許，遂以兗、豫定，是其應也。

translations.literal: Later there were the violent disorders of Dong Zhuo and Li Jue, the Yellow Turbans and Black Mountain rebels raging; Cao Wu welcomed the emperor to the capital at Xu and settled Yan and Yu — this was its fulfillment.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter Dong Zhuo and Li Jue plunged the realm into chaos, the Yellow Turbans and Black Mountain rebels ran riot, and Cao Cao brought the emperor to Xu and secured Yan and Yu — the omen was fulfilled.

sentences.zh: 一曰：「心為天王，大兵升殿，天下大亂之兆也。

translations.literal: One reading says: "The Heart is the Celestial King; great armies ascend the hall — a portent of great disorder throughout the realm.
translations.idiomatic: One interpretation holds: "The Heart is the Celestial King — when great armies enter the throne hall, it foretells empire-wide calamity.

sentences.zh: 」韓馥以為尾箕燕興之祥，故奉幽州牧劉虞，虞既距之，又尋滅亡，固已非矣。

translations.literal: " Han Fu took the Tail and Winnower as a sign of Yan's rise, and therefore installed Liu Yu as Governor of Youzhou; Yu refused it and soon perished — clearly this was already wrong.
translations.idiomatic: " Han Fu read the Tail and Winnower as a sign that Yan would rise, and so offered the throne to Liu Yu of Youzhou; Yu refused and soon perished — the reading had already missed the mark.

sentences.zh: 尾為燕，又為吳，此非公孫度，則孫權也。

translations.literal: The Tail stands for Yan and also for Wu — if this was not Gongsun Du, then it was Sun Quan.
translations.idiomatic: The Tail governs Yan and also Wu — the omen pointed not to Gongsun Du but to Sun Quan.

sentences.zh: 度偏據僻陋，然亦郊祀備物，皆為改漢矣。

translations.literal: Du held a remote backwater, yet he also performed suburban sacrifices with full regalia — all of this amounted to replacing Han.
translations.idiomatic: Gongsun Du held only a remote corner of the realm, yet he offered suburban sacrifices with full imperial rite — in effect he had cast off Han.

sentences.zh: 建安二十二年，四星又聚。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year of Jian'an, four stars gathered again.
translations.idiomatic: In Jian'an 22 the four planets converged once more.

sentences.zh: 二十五年而魏文受禪，此為四星三聚而易行矣。

translations.literal: Twenty-five years later Wen of Wei received the abdication — this was the third gathering of four stars with Changing Motion.
translations.idiomatic: Twenty-five years later Emperor Wen of Wei accepted the abdication — a third four-star convergence with Changing Motion.

sentences.zh: 蜀臣亦引後聚為劉備之應。

translations.literal: Ministers of Shu also cited the later gathering as the fulfillment for Liu Bei.
translations.idiomatic: Shu officials likewise claimed the later convergence as Liu Bei's omen fulfilled.

sentences.zh: 案太元十九年、義熙三年九月，四星各一聚，而宋有天下，與魏同也。

translations.literal: Examining the nineteenth year of Taiyuan and the ninth month of the third year of Yiyuan, four stars each formed one gathering, and Song possessed the realm — the same as Wei.
translations.idiomatic: Reviewing Taiyuan 19 and the ninth month of Yiyuan 3, four planets each converged once, and Song won the realm — the same pattern as Wei.

sentences.zh: 魚豢雲：「五星聚冀方，而魏有天下。

translations.literal: Yu Huan says: "Five stars gathered in the Ji region, and Wei possessed the realm.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Huan writes: "When five stars converged toward Ji, Wei won the empire.

sentences.zh: 」熒惑入輿鬼。

translations.literal: " Mars entered the Celestial Cart and Ghost.
translations.idiomatic: " Mars entered the Celestial Cart and Ghost asterism.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「兵喪。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "War and mourning.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "War and death in arms.

sentences.zh: 」太白犯南河。

translations.literal: " Venus encroached on the Southern River.
translations.idiomatic: " Venus trespassed against the Southern River star.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「兵起。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "Armies will rise.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "War will break out.

sentences.zh: 」後皆有應。

translations.literal: " Later all had fulfillment.
translations.idiomatic: " In every case the omens were later fulfilled.

sentences.zh: 五月壬辰，太白犯右執法，晝見，占同上。

translations.literal: On the renchen day of the fifth month Venus encroached on the Right Law Enforcer and was visible in daylight — the prognostication is the same as above.
translations.idiomatic: On a renchen day in the fifth month Venus trespassed against the Right Law Enforcer and shone by day — the omen was read as above.

sentences.zh: 七月庚午，月奄鉤鈐。

translations.literal: On the gengwu day of the seventh month the moon covered the Hooked Clasp.
translations.idiomatic: On a gengwu day in the seventh month the moon eclipsed the Hooked Clasp asterism.

translations.idiomatic: " On a dingsi day Venus entered the Forest of Spears.

translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "Covert intrigue will arise.

sentences.zh: 」一曰：「有邊兵。

sentences.zh: 占曰：「為旱，為疫，為亂臣。

translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "It foretells drought, pestilence, and treacherous ministers.

sentences.zh: 」五月甲申，彗星出天市，掃帝座，在房、心。

translations.literal: " On the jiashen day of the fifth month a broom star appeared in the Heavenly Market, sweeping the Imperial Seat, in the Room and Heart.
translations.idiomatic: " On a jiashen day in the fifth month a comet blazed in the Heavenly Market enclosure, sweeping the Imperial Seat in the Room and Heart asterisms.

sentences.zh: 房、心，宋之分野。

translations.literal: The Room and Heart are the allotted territory of Song.
translations.idiomatic: The Room and Heart asterisms govern the territory of Song.

sentences.zh: 案占，得彗柄者興，除舊佈新，宋興之象。

translations.literal: Examining the prognostication: he who gains the comet's handle rises; removing the old and spreading the new — an image of Song's rise.
translations.idiomatic: The established reading held that whoever seizes the comet's handle rises to power — sweeping away the old and ordering the new — a sign that Song would ascend.

sentences.zh: 癸卯，熒惑從行入太微。

translations.literal: On the guimao day Mars, moving in tandem, entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: On a guimao day Mars, traveling in company, entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 甲辰，犯右執法。

translations.literal: On the jiachen day it encroached on the Right Law Enforcer.
translations.idiomatic: On a jiachen day it trespassed against the Right Law Enforcer star.

sentences.zh: 庚申，太白從行從右掖門入太微。

translations.idiomatic: On a gengshen day Venus, traveling in company, entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure through the Right Rear Gate.

sentences.zh: 丁卯，奄左執法。

translations.literal: On the dingmao day it covered the Left Law Enforcer.
translations.idiomatic: On a dingmao day it eclipsed the Left Law Enforcer star.

sentences.zh: 十一月癸亥，月入畢，占同上。

translations.literal: On the guihai day of the eleventh month the moon entered the Net — the prognostication is the same as above.
translations.idiomatic: On a guihai day in the eleventh month the moon entered the Net asterism — the omen was read as above.

sentences.zh: 乙未，月入輿鬼而暈。

translations.literal: On the yiwei day the moon entered the Celestial Cart and Ghost and was surrounded by a halo.
translations.idiomatic: On a yiwei day the moon entered the Celestial Cart and Ghost asterism with a corona.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「主憂，財寶出。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "The ruler will suffer anxiety; treasure will go forth.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "The sovereign will grieve, and wealth will flow out of the treasury.

sentences.zh: 」一曰：「暈，有赦。」

translations.literal: " Another reading says: "A halo portends an amnesty."
translations.idiomatic: " Another interpretation holds: "The halo foretells a general amnesty."

sentences.zh: 十二年五月甲申，月犯歲星，在左角。

translations.literal: On the jiashen day of the fifth month of the twelfth year the moon encroached on Jupiter at the Left Horn.
translations.idiomatic: On a jiashen day in the fifth month of Yiyuan 12 the moon trespassed against Jupiter at the Left Horn star.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「為饑。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "It portends famine.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "Famine will follow.

sentences.zh: 留房、心之間，宋之分野，與武王伐紂同，得歲者王。

translations.literal: Lingering between the Room and Heart — the allotted territory of Song, the same as when King Wu attacked Zhou; he who gains Jupiter becomes king.
translations.idiomatic: Lingering between the Room and Heart — Song's allotted field — the same omen as when King Wu overthrew Zhou: whoever holds Jupiter wins the throne.

sentences.zh: 」于時晉始封高祖為宋公。

translations.literal: " At that time Jin had just enfeoffed Emperor Gaozu as Duke of Song.
translations.idiomatic: " At that very time the Jin court had just enfeoffed Emperor Gaozu as Duke of Song.

sentences.zh: 六月壬子，太白從行入太微右掖門。

translations.idiomatic: On a renzi day in the sixth month Venus, traveling in company, entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure through the Right Rear Gate.

translations.idiomatic: On a jisi day the moon trespassed against the Net asterism — the omen was read as above.

translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month the moon trespassed against the Ox asterism.

translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "Mass executions will sweep the empire.

sentences.zh: 十月戊申，月犯畢，占悉同上。

translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "The realm will face grave concern.

translations.idiomatic: " On a jiayin day the moon trespassed against the Net asterism — the omen was read as above.

sentences.zh: 乙卯，填星犯太微，留積七十餘日。

translations.literal: On the yimao day Saturn encroached on the Supreme Palace Enclosure and remained accumulated more than seventy days.
translations.idiomatic: On a yimao day Saturn trespassed against the Supreme Palace Enclosure and lingered there for more than seventy days.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「亡君之戒。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "This is a warning of the ruler's destruction.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "It warns that the sovereign may be lost.

sentences.zh: 」壬戌，月犯太微，占同上。

translations.literal: " On the renxu day the moon encroached on the Supreme Palace Enclosure — the prognostication is the same as above.
translations.idiomatic: " On a renxu day the moon trespassed against the Supreme Palace Enclosure — the omen was read as above.

sentences.zh: 十一月，月於太微，奄填星。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, at the Supreme Palace Enclosure, the moon covered Saturn.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, within the Supreme Palace Enclosure, the moon eclipsed Saturn.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「王者惡之。」

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "The king finds it ominous."
translations.idiomatic: The omen read: "The sovereign would reckon it ill."

sentences.zh: 十四年三月癸醜，太白犯五諸侯，占同上。

translations.idiomatic: On a renshen day in the fourth month the moon trespassed against Saturn in the Extended Net asterism.

translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "Empire-wide mourning will follow.

sentences.zh: 」五月庚子，月犯太微，占同上。

translations.literal: " On the gengzi day of the fifth month the moon encroached on the Supreme Palace Enclosure — the prognostication is the same as above.
translations.idiomatic: " On a gengzi day in the fifth month the moon trespassed against the Supreme Palace Enclosure — the omen was read as above.

sentences.zh: 壬子，有星孛於北斗魁中。

translations.idiomatic: On a renzi day a comet blazed within the Northern Dipper's head.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「有聖人受命。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "A sage will receive the Mandate.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "A sage will receive Heaven's Mandate.

sentences.zh: 」七月甲辰，熒惑犯輿鬼。

translations.literal: " On the jiachen day of the seventh month Mars encroached on the Celestial Cart and Ghost.

translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "Qin will go to war.

translations.idiomatic: " On a dingsi day the moon trespassed against the Eastern Well asterism.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「軍將死。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "Army commanders will die.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "Army commanders will perish.

sentences.zh: 」癸亥，彗星出太微西，柄起上相星下，芒漸長至十餘丈，進歸北斗紫微中台。

translations.literal: " On the guihai day a comet appeared west of Supreme Palace Enclosure; its handle rose below the Upper Minister star, its tail gradually lengthening to more than ten zhang, advancing to return to the Northern Dipper, Purple Forbidden Enclosure, and Central Terrace.
translations.idiomatic: " On a guihai day a comet blazed west of the Supreme Palace Enclosure; its nucleus rose beneath the Upper Minister star, its tail lengthening to more than ten zhang as it swept toward the Northern Dipper, the Purple Forbidden Enclosure, and the Central Terrace.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「彗出太微，社稷亡，天下易王。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "When a comet emerges from Supreme Palace Enclosure, the altars of state will perish and the realm will change its ruler.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "When a comet emerges from the Supreme Palace Enclosure, the dynasty will fall and the throne will change hands.

sentences.zh: 入北斗紫微，帝宮空。

translations.literal: Entering the Northern Dipper and Purple Forbidden Enclosure, the imperial palace will stand empty.
translations.idiomatic: Its entry into the Northern Dipper and Purple Forbidden Enclosure means the imperial palace will stand vacant.

sentences.zh: 」一曰：「天下得聖主。

translations.literal: " Another reading says: "The realm will gain a sage ruler.
translations.idiomatic: " Another interpretation holds: "The realm will gain a sage sovereign.

sentences.zh: 」八月甲子，太白犯軒轅。

translations.literal: " On the jiazi day of the eighth month Venus encroached on the Yellow Dragon.
translations.idiomatic: " On a jiazi day in the eighth month, Venus trespassed against the Yellow Dragon asterism.

sentences.zh: 癸酉，填星入太微，犯右執法，因留太微中，積二百餘日乃去。

translations.literal: On the guiyou day Saturn entered Supreme Palace Enclosure, encroached on the Right Law Enforcer, and remained within Supreme Palace Enclosure for more than two hundred days before departing.
translations.idiomatic: On a guiyou day Saturn entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure, crossed the Right Law Enforcer star, and lingered within the enclosure for more than two hundred days before moving on.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「填星守太微，亡君之戒，有徙王。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "When Saturn stations at Supreme Palace Enclosure, it is a warning of a perished ruler; there will be a transferred king.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "When Saturn lingers in the Supreme Palace Enclosure, it warns of a fallen sovereign and a king who will be displaced.

sentences.zh: 」九月乙未，太白入太微，犯左執法。

translations.literal: " On the yiwei day of the ninth month Venus entered Supreme Palace Enclosure and encroached on the Left Law Enforcer.
translations.idiomatic: " On a yiwei day in the ninth month, Venus entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure and trespassed against the Left Law Enforcer.

sentences.zh: 丁巳，月入太微。

translations.idiomatic: On a dingsi day the moon entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「大人憂。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "Great men will suffer anxiety.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "The highest officers of state will be afflicted.

sentences.zh: 」十月癸巳，熒惑入太微，犯西蕃上將，仍從行至左掖門內，留二十日乃逆行。

translations.literal: " On the guisi day of the tenth month Mars entered Supreme Palace Enclosure, encroached on the Western Enclosure's Upper General, continued following along to within the Left Flank Gate, remained for twenty days, and then moved in retrograde.
translations.idiomatic: " On a guisi day in the tenth month Mars entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure, crossed the Western Enclosure's Upper General, proceeded to within the Left Flank Gate, lingered twenty days, and then turned retrograde.

sentences.zh: 至恭帝元熙元年三月五日，出西蕃上將西三尺許，又從還入太微。

translations.literal: By the fifth day of the third month of the first year of Yuanxi under Emperor Gong it emerged about three chi west of the Western Enclosure's Upper General, then returned and re-entered Supreme Palace Enclosure.
translations.idiomatic: By the fifth day of the third month of Yuanxi 1, during the reign of Emperor Gong, it emerged roughly three chi west of the Western Enclosure's Upper General, then swung back and re-entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure.

sentences.zh: 時填星在太微，熒惑繞填星成鉤已。

translations.literal: At that time Saturn was in Supreme Palace Enclosure, and Mars circled Saturn forming a hook pattern.
translations.idiomatic: At that time Saturn lingered in the Supreme Palace Enclosure while Mars looped around it in a hook-shaped configuration.

sentences.zh: 其年四月二十七日丙戌，從端門出。

translations.literal: On the twenty-seventh day of the fourth month of that year, on bingxu day, it departed through the End Gate.
translations.idiomatic: On the twenty-seventh day of the fourth month of that year, a bingxu day, it departed through the End Gate.

sentences.zh: 占曰：「熒惑與填星鉤已，天下更紀。

translations.literal: The prognostication reads: "When Mars and Saturn form a hook pattern, the realm will change its era.
translations.idiomatic: The prognostication reads: "When Mars and Saturn form a hook around one another, the dynasty will change its reign title.

sentences.zh: 」甲申，月入太微，占同上。

translations.literal: " On the jiashen day the moon entered Supreme Palace Enclosure; the prognostication is the same as above.
translations.idiomatic: " On a jiashen day the moon entered the Supreme Palace Enclosure; the omen was read as above.

sentences.zh: 十一年正月，高祖討司馬休之、魯宗之等，潰奔長安。

translations.literal: In the first month of the eleventh year Emperor Gaozu attacked Sima Xiuzhi, Lu Zongzhi, and others; they broke and fled to Chang'an.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the eleventh year Emperor Gaozu campaigned against Sima Xiuzhi, Lu Zongzhi, and their allies; they broke and fled toward Chang'an.

sentences.zh: 五月，林邑寇交州，交州刺史杜慧度距戰於九真，大為所敗。

translations.literal: In the fifth month Linyi raided Jiaozhou; Governor of Jiaozhou Du Huidu resisted at Jiuzhen and suffered a great defeat.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month Linyi invaded Jiaozhou; the Governor of Jiaozhou Du Huidu gave battle at Jiuzhen and was routed.

sentences.zh: 十二年七月，高祖伐羌。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the twelfth year Emperor Gaozu campaigned against the Qiang.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the twelfth year Emperor Gaozu marched against the Qiang.

sentences.zh: 十月，前驅定陝、洛。

translations.literal: In the tenth month the vanguard secured Shaan and Luoyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month the advance forces secured Shaan and Luoyang.

sentences.zh: 十三年三月，索頭大眾緣河為寇，高祖討之奔退，其別帥托跋嵩交戰，又大破之，嵩眾殲焉。

translations.literal: In the third month of the thirteenth year the great host of the Tuoba chieftain raided along the Yellow River; Emperor Gaozu attacked them and they fled in retreat; his subordinate commander Tuoba Song joined battle and was again greatly defeated, and Song's forces were annihilated.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of the thirteenth year the Tuoba chieftain's great army raided along the Yellow River; Emperor Gaozu struck and drove them back in flight; his subordinate commander Tuoba Song gave battle and was shattered again, and Song's entire force was wiped out.

sentences.zh: 進複攻關。

translations.literal: Advancing, he again attacked the passes.
translations.idiomatic: Pressing forward, he again stormed the frontier passes.

sentences.zh: 八月，擒姚泓，司、兗、秦、雍悉平，索頭凶懼。

translations.literal: In the eighth month Yao Hong was captured; Si, Yan, Qin, and Yong were all pacified, and the Tuoba chieftain was struck with dread.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month Yao Hong was taken prisoner; Si, Yan, Qin, and Yong were all brought under control, and the Tuoba ruler was gripped with fear.

sentences.zh: 十四年，高祖還彭城，受宋公。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year Emperor Gaozu returned to Pengcheng and received the title Duke of Song.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year Emperor Gaozu returned to Pengcheng and was invested as Duke of Song.

sentences.zh: 十一月，左僕射前將軍劉穆之卒。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month Left Vice Director and Forward General Liu Muzhi died.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month the Left Vice Director and Forward General Liu Muzhi died.

sentences.zh: 明年，西虜寇長安，雍州刺史硃齡石諸軍陷沒，官軍舍而東。

translations.literal: The following year the western barbarians raided Chang'an; the armies of Governor of Yongzhou Zhu Lingshi and others were lost, and the government forces abandoned the west and withdrew eastward.
translations.idiomatic: The following year the western enemy struck Chang'an; the armies under the Governor of Yongzhou Zhu Lingshi were destroyed, and the imperial forces abandoned the region and withdrew east.

sentences.zh: 十二月，安帝崩，母弟琅邪王踐阼，是曰恭帝。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month Emperor An died; his younger brother by the same mother, the Prince of Langye, ascended the throne — this was Emperor Gong.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Emperor An died; his younger uterine brother, the Prince of Langye, ascended the throne — he is known as Emperor Gong.
